jobs.title: Sentinel Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be availableCLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: YesCLEARANCE TYPE: SecretTRAVEL: Yes, 25% of the Time

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking **Staff Software Engineer.** This position will be located in **Huntsville, AL** and will support the Sentinel Program.

NGDS is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to lead the strategy, design, and implementation of our software automation test architecture. This role will own the vision and execution for a Python-based automation framework leveraging Northrop Grumman tools, including the Software Requirements Checker Tool (SRCT), to enable robust, certifiable test solutions. The Software Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end technical architecture and all deliverable products for the Software Test team. This includes driving critical technical decisions, defining and evolving the test framework, and ensuring test scripts and infrastructure fully support program certification objectives. You will be the primary technical authority for software test automation on the program, partnering closely with systems engineering, software development, and program leadership to deliver a high-quality, certifiable test solution on schedule. In this role, you will provide strong technical leadership by:

* Setting the technical direction for the Software Test team and ensuring alignment with program goals and schedules
* Defining and guiding software design approaches for the Python framework and SRCT integrations
* Establishing and enforcing architecture and coding standards to ensure scalability, maintainability, and compliance
* Leading the team to achieve timely certification of requirements, proactively removing technical obstacles and managing risk
* Lead and coordinate software test activities across multiple sites, ensuring consistent processes, quality, and communication.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to develop robust test methodologies, perform requirements traceability to test cases, and generate clear, complete test documentation.
* Design, implement, and maintain automated test environments to increase test coverage, efficiency, and repeatability.
* Actively mentor team members, sharing expertise, providing feedback, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Plan and coordinate software test release activities in alignment with broader program schedules, resolving dependencies and risks proactively.
* Exercise sound judgment in selecting and executing courses of action to achieve program objectives; work closely with systems engineering, software development, and management to ensure a high-quality, efficient software lifecycle.
* Oversee and manage the quality and timeliness of delivered products, identifying potential issues early and driving remediation before they impact customers or milestones.
* Serve as the primary technical test representative in reviews with senior management and customer stakeholders, clearly communicating status, risks, and recommendations.

**Position Benefits**

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
* 401k
* Educational Assistance
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
* Paid Time Off
* Health & Wellness Resources
* Employee Discounts

This positions standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree 12+ years of relevant experience; 10+ years of relevant experience with a master’s degree; 8+ years of relevant experience with a Ph.D; or 4 additional years in lieu of a degree
* Must be a U.S. citizen with an active U.S. Government DoD Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope (< 6 yrs), with an ability to obtain and maintain SAP approval within a reasonable period, as determined by the company to meet its business need.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience leading projects and/or driving team performance to meet schedule commitments.
* Minimum of 2 years of demonstrated experience in embedded and/or application software test planning and test execution.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including hands-on experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software and/or test scripts.
* Experience managing a product team and delivering periodic, process-driven releases for a government customer.
* Solid background in software testing and troubleshooting, including participation in or support of a Software Review Board (SRB) or equivalent governance process.
* Experience developing and reviewing requirements, and ensuring vertical traceability across a program-defined specification/document tree.
* Experience using Cameo (MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler) or equivalent model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tool.
* Experience supporting informal integration as well as formal qualification test efforts.
* Experience developing Basis of Estimate (BOE) artifacts and supporting Integrated Master Schedule (IMS)

jobs.title: Software Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
EOS Defense Systems USA designs and produces highly accurate, cost-effective, modular, and scalable Remote Weapon Systems that give warfighters a decisive edge in counter-UAS and ground-to-ground missions. Trusted across platforms, we're at the forefront of defense innovation.  
  
At EOS our people are our strength. Here, engineers own their work throughout their life cycle. Working side by side with a small, multi-disciplinary team in a safe, collaborative workplace. The pace is fast, the mission is real, and you'll build your skills and grow your career while advancing technology that matters, from advanced effectors to AI. If you want hands-on engineering with real ownership and a direct line to the mission, EOS Defense Systems USA is the place to be.

**Software Engineering Lead (Remote Weapon Systems)**  
  
EOS is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Software Engineer Lead to direct a small, dedicated team of software engineers in the design, development, test, and integration of embedded software solutions of our high-performing, world-leading Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) development programs. The ideal candidate will set the technical direction for the team while cultivating a strong culture of ownership. You will be instrumental in providing senior-level technical leadership, mentoring junior talent, managing daily tasking, and maintaining strict accountability for engineering quality and delivery schedules.  
  
The role oversees cross-platform software for line-replaceable units (LRUs), command-and-control (C2) interfaces, and discrete electrical signals that enable reliable remote operation of our weapon systems. You will collaborate directly with our electrical engineering team, reviewing PCB schematics and component data sheets to ensure hardware aligns with software requirements. This is a critical leadership role that directly impacts our program success and team cohesion.  
  
This is an on-site position located at our facility.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Technical Leadership & Oversight: Serve as the technical authority for the software engineering team, guiding the design, development, and integration of complex software solutions for RWS's.
* Team Mentorship & Cohesion: Actively mentor and coach younger engineers to accelerate their professional growth; build a highly collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* Tasking & Resource Management: Manage, prioritize, and assign engineering tasks across multiple concurrent programs to optimize team bandwidth and satisfy project milestones.
* Culture of Ownership & Accountability: Foster a strong culture of ownership where team members take pride in and maintain full accountability for the quality, reliability, and on-time delivery of their products.
* Schedule & Quality Management: Maintain engineering schedules, conduct rigorous design reviews, and ensure all engineering deliverables meet stringent aerospace/ defense quality standards.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with systems, electrical, and mechanical engineering leads to seamlessly integrate software into weapon platform architectures.
* System Integration & Field Support: Work cross-functionally to integrate software with RWS systems; travel as required to support customer reviews, field integration, and live-fire test operations.

  
**Required Qualifications:**  

* Education: BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline.
* Experience: 8+ years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, with a strong focus on embedded systems.
* Platform & Hardware Expertise: Proven development experience with Microchip microcontrollers/microprocessors, their development ecosystems, and general C/C++ bare-metal and RTOS programming.
* Industry & Security: Demonstrated experience working in a Government Contracting Environment. Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret-level U.S. security clearance.
* Core Competencies: Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; willingness to travel to customer reviews or test ranges.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Advanced Degree: Master's degree in a relevant engineering or computer science field.
* Linux Build Systems & Tools: Hands-on experience building custom embedded Linux distributions using the Yocto Project.
* Middleware & Networking: Proficiency with DDS publish/subscribe middleware, TCP/UDP sockets, RS-232, and Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) protocols.
* Advanced Weapon System Tech: Experience developing Command and Control (C2) software, integrating EO/IR or radar systems, and exposure to EO/IR test and evaluation instruments.
* Next-Gen Innovation: Familiarity with AI/Machine Learning concepts and their practical application to advance automation and targeting software in remote weapon systems

**Outstanding Benefits/Perks:**  

* Excellent insurance coverage
* 401(k) match
* Generous PTO
* Tuition Reimbursement
* 9/80 Work Schedule

EOS Defense Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identification and sexual orientation) or national origin in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. An Equal Opportunity Employer for disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, other protected veterans, and armed forces service medal veterans. An Equal Opportunity Employer of individuals with disabilities. We participate in E-Verify.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Torch Technologies**

Thank you for your interest in employment with Torch Technologies. We are a 100% employee-owned, Certified Great Place To Work and named Best Places to Work in Huntsville/Madison County, headquartered in Huntsville, AL. Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. As one of the nation’s top 100 defense companies, the services we provide directly support the men and women who serve our country. Our corporate mission sums up the pride our employee-owners take in the work we do: “Lighting the Pathway of Freedom”. And, as a Certified Evergreen ESOP, we have made the commitment to grow and sustain our company for the next 100 years! Come grow with us!

Torch Technologies Inc., is seeking a **Senior Systems Engineer** to design, integrate, deploy, and maintain complex systems and network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have strong systems engineering experience, advanced networking knowledge, and experience managing network switches and remotely administering distributed systems. The role requires the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues while ensuring system performance, reliability, and security.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Generate and maintain network diagrams, system architecture diagrams, infrastructure layouts, and data flow diagrams.
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot network switches, routers, firewalls, VLANs, trunking, port assignments, and network services.
* Manage switch configurations, firmware updates, access control lists, port security, and configuration backups.
* Apply knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing and switching protocols, DNS, DHCP, and network segmentation.
* Perform remote administration, monitoring, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of systems across distributed environments.
* Diagnose network performance issues and resolve complex connectivity, hardware, software, and system integration problems.
* Lead system integration, testing, verification, and validation activities to ensure technical requirements are met.
Collaborate with engineering, IT, cybersecurity, and operations teams to deliver and sustain technical capabilities.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* US Citizenship.
* Master’s or Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, a related field or equivalent experience.
* 10 or more years applicable progressively complex systems design engineering experience, including integration of complex hardware/software systems.
* Significant experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, network engineering, or a related technical field.
* Strong knowledge of network architecture, TCP/IP, VLANs, subnetting, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience configuring and managing network switches, including VLANs, trunk ports, access ports, and switch management.
Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux environments, network services, and infrastructure management.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience managing enterprise network equipment and multi-site or distributed environments.
* Familiarity with routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP, network access control lists, VPNs, and network security.
* Experience with switch firmware upgrades, configuration backups, network monitoring, and configuration change control.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.  

  

**Schedule:** M-F; 8-5

**Work Location:** Customer- site

**Travel:** Yes, 0-10%

**Relocation Assistance Available:** No

**Position Contingent Upon Award of Contract:** Yes

#LI-TS

  

**Benefits:**

Torch Technologies is proud to offer a stable and professional work environment, a competitive salary, and an excellent, comprehensive benefit package including: ESOP participation, 401(k) match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, Health Saving Accounts and Health Reimbursement Accounts, EAP, education assistance, paid time off, and holidays.

Only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Employment at Torch Technologies is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, citizenship, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Specialist, Healthcare & Commercial Facilities
jobs.description:
**Build power systems for a new era of construction**
-----------------------------------------------------

Imagine large, precisely manufactured building sections arriving on site and connecting seamlessly. That’s the Design Manufacture Construct (DMC) system in action—and it’s how a 350-person organization with eleven production lines is delivering the 2x2x2 promise: twice as good, twice as fast, and twice the value.

### **Your mission**

Lead the electrical design thread through the full DMC lifecycle. You’ll turn requirements into resilient facility power systems, validate performance and safety, and ensure designs flow cleanly from model to manufacturing to installation—especially in demanding healthcare environments.

### **How you’ll contribute**

* Develop and detail electrical distribution, lighting, and related systems to meet client needs across small and large projects.
* Coordinate with engineers, architects, PMs, and construction professionals to set design criteria and iterate intelligently.
* Run studies that matter: overcurrent protective device selective coordination, arc-flash hazard, illumination, and energy performance.
* Support production: 3D modeling, selecting manufacturing and construction methods, assisting with fabrication, testing, and field implementation.
* Engage customers and partners to clarify goals, operating contexts, specifications, cost, and feasibility for new facility electrical systems.
* Audit drawings/specifications for compliance with relevant quality and regulatory requirements.
* Help manage CAD/Revit modeling activities and keep the work on schedule.
* Work shoulder-to-shoulder with installers in manufacturing and construction to elevate quality, flow, and efficiency.
* Back the project lead in coordinating contributions from managers, engineers, drafters, and manufacturing teams across all phases.

### **What you’ll need**

#### **Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Architectural Engineering.
* Experience in facility electrical engineering.
* Familiarity with codes/standards including the NEC and NFPA 99.
* Team-first mindset with the ability to operate independently.
* Punctual, organized, and deadline-focused.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

#### **Preferred qualifications**

* Professional Engineering (PE) license.
* Experience designing healthcare facilities.
* Revit proficiency plus AutoCAD and CADMEP.
* Electrical analysis experience with EasyPower, ETAP, or SKM; familiarity with Dapper/Captor.

### **Core proficiencies**

* National Electrical Code (NEC)
* Electrical / Electronic Systems
* Electrical System and Equipment Design
* Electrical systems regulations for electrical systems
* NFPA 99

### **Tools and platforms**

* CAD Software (AutoCAD)
* AutoCAD
* CAD/Revit design modeling
* CADMEP
* Revit

### **Benefits that back your impact**

* 10–15% Bonus
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible spending accounts
* Paid time off
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan

### **Our commitment**

It is the policy of Deploy's Clientto use ability and willingness to contribute to our team effort as the criteriafor making employment related decisions, regardless of an individual's race, color, religion, sex, nationalorigin, age, disability, or other protected status. In addition, we strictly prohibit the harassment of anyemployee because of his/her race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexualorientation and gender identity), disability, or other protected status.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**10 Fitness**

**Your Best Life Starts Here**

**Our mission is to help individuals live the best lives possible through better health and inclusion in a positive community!**

***365 Member Access***

Seamless integration. Total control. Real human support.

365 Member Access, 10 Fitness's sister company, was created by operators who needed better control over doors, amenities, and member experience.

**Lead Software Engineer**

**Job Description**

The Lead Software Engineer at 10 Fitness is a hands-on technical leader responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting the software systems serving 10 Fitness and 365 Member Access. This position partners with the CIO, leads and develops engineering team members, and helps ensure that critical software systems remain reliable, secure, and effective.

**Job Duties:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain company software, cloud services, and applications.
* Lead the continued development and support of the 365 Member Access platform, including member access systems, Android kiosks, connected hardware, and third-party integrations.
* Oversee production system reliability and security, including monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and recovery procedures.
* Establish and follow sound engineering practices for code quality, testing, documentation, source control, and deployment.
* Plan and execute assigned projects in collaboration with the CIO; communicate progress, timelines, risks, and obstacles in a timely manner.
* Maintain technical documentation and participate in the on-call support rotation as required.

**Management:**

* Lead, coach, and mentor software engineering team members while remaining actively involved in technical work.
* Assign and monitor work, provide technical guidance and code reviews, and promote cross-training and knowledge sharing.
* Set clear expectations, hold team members accountable, and model the 10 Fitness core values and company policies.

**Qualifications:**

* Approximately 7 or more years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including technical leadership or mentoring experience.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js; experience with cloud-based applications and AWS or a comparable platform.
* Experience with APIs, third-party integrations, automated testing, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and secure development practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and project-management skills.

jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

Rivet is looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to own perceptual calibration for our next-generation AR wearables and devices running Android and embedded Linux. Accurate camera, IMU, and display calibration is what every tracking and display experience rests on: it keeps tracking stable, overlays registered to the real world, and rendering comfortable. This role spans calibration algorithms, calibration station and process design, and factory deployment, taking calibration from the lab bench to factory production lines. You will work closely with hardware, mechanical, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams to deliver calibration that is accurate, repeatable, and efficient at production scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Build computer vision and signal processing algorithms that calibrate the geometric intrinsics, extrinsics, and time offsets of cameras, IMUs, and XR displays.
* Develop perceptual calibration processes for Rivet’s range of wearables and devices, covering calibration station design (sensor and target selection, metrology hardware requirements) and controlled data capture conditions.
* Deploy data capture processes and calibration binaries to factory sites, working with contract manufacturers (CMs) through bring-up, ramp, and mass production.
* Set factory calibration limits using Gage Repeatability & Reproducibility (GR&R) studies and Design of Experiments (DOE), and establish failure analysis processes backed by automated and agentic diagnosis and documented runbooks.
* Reduce calibration cycle time through software profiling and refinement, additional or alternative station hardware, and process pipelining.
* Develop tooling, visualization, and debugging workflows for end-to-end validation of perceptual calibration, including lab verification of factory calibration results.
* Partner with hardware, mechanical, optical, and electrical engineering, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams to set calibration requirements, design-for-calibration tolerances, and station specifications, and to deliver calibrated products end-to-end.

**Requirements**

* Proven hands-on experience shipping camera, IMU, and/or display calibration solutions into production devices, from lab prototype through factory ramp.
* Demonstrated hands-on ability to debug calibration failures, with a deep understanding of both the front-end perception (target detection, feature extraction, data association) and back-end optimization (sensor models, nonlinear least squares, observability) components of geometric calibration pipelines.
* PhD + at least 3 years (or MS + at least 7 years) of relevant professional experience.
* Experience with robot arms or motion stages for calibration data capture.
* Strong background in multi-view geometry, camera and IMU sensor models, coordinate frames, nonlinear optimization, and statistics.
* Proficient in C++ or Rust for performance-critical code, and in Python for analysis, automation, and tooling.
* Experience developing on Android or embedded Linux devices.
* Strong understanding of performance optimization, profiling, synchronization, and CPU/GPU/memory tradeoffs.
* Ability to partner across hardware, mechanical, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams, and with contract manufacturers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SLAM, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), or online calibration.
* Experience calibrating XR displays (distortion, binocular alignment, display-to-camera extrinsics).
* Experience building wearable, robotics, aerospace, defense, or embedded perception systems.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing test statistics (GR&R, DOE, SPC, Cpk) and high-volume factory bring-up.

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.  
  
Rivet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Certain roles may require U.S. Person status, security clearance eligibility, or other requirements imposed by law or government contract.

jobs.title: Staff Systems Engineer - Camera
jobs.description:
**About 1X**

We're building humanoid robots that work in home - doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it's not.

To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing - at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you're inspired by this, you'll thrive here. We've been at this since 2014 and we're at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us.

NEO is our flagship - a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We're not demoing it - we're shipping it. We're excited to meet you, if this excites you.

If you've spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We're scaling, we're hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time - safely creating abundance for all.

**About the Team**

The Core team builds and owns the core C++ infrastructure that NEO’s entire stack runs on, from sensor pipelines, motor control interfaces, networking, inter-process communication, and the foundational libraries that ship on every robot. Our code executes thousands of times per second on hardware moving through the real world, and its correctness and performance directly determines what every other team can build and ship. If you want to work on the systems layer that makes physical AI possible at scale, this is that team.

**Your Charter**

Own the camera stack NEO sees through, from the sensor and lens selected for the robot to the calibrated, rectified frames every perception model consumes. This is critical-path work: no vision model is better than the images it is handed, and nothing downstream survives a camera that is miscalibrated, badly tuned, or quietly dropping frames. You will own that path from vendor selection through end-of-line calibration on the production line and out to robots already working in homes.

**Key Outcomes**

* Own camera selection end to end: define sensor, lens, and module requirements with the hardware and perception teams, run the trade studies, and carry a choice through vendor engagement and bring-up on real hardware
* Deliver a camera pipeline that holds up in production: sensor drivers, multi-camera synchronization and timestamping, and frame delivery that meets its latency budget without dropping frames or destabilizing timestamps
* Tune the image path for machines rather than for people: exposure, white balance, and dynamic range chosen so perception models are accurate in real homes, including the low light and hard backlight a living room actually presents
* Make calibration a production process, not a lab procedure: intrinsics and extrinsics calibrated on the line inside cycle time, validated automatically, monitored for drift across the fleet, and recoverable in the field

**Key Competencies**

* **Camera systems depth** understanding sensors, optics, and ISP as one system, and how an image travels a robotics stack from capture through transport, compression, and transformation to the model that consumes it
* **Lives at the hardware boundary** debugging across MIPI CSI-2, serdes links, I2C, PoE, and power and clock sequencing, and treating dropped frames, timestamp instability, and bandwidth limits as everyday failure modes rather than mysteries
* **Calibration rigor** treating calibration as measurement with error bars, reasoning about tolerances and uncertainty, and knowing how a calibration error propagates into what a perception model gets wrong
* **Thinks in fleets, not units** designing calibration and diagnostics that survive a production line at volume and robots already in homes, not just a bench with a careful operator

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years shipping camera or imaging software in production systems: robotics, autonomous vehicles, consumer devices, or AR and VR
* Hands-on experience bringing up image sensors on embedded Linux, including V4L2, MIPI CSI-2, and the driver and device tree work that comes with it
* Demonstrated experience with camera intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, including validating calibration quality rather than trusting a solver's output
* Strong C++ in performance-critical systems, with the profiling and debugging habits to find where frames and milliseconds actually go

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with ISP tuning and image quality evaluation, especially where the consumer is a perception model rather than a person
* Experience taking calibration into manufacturing: fixture and station design, cycle time, yield, and failure analysis on build data
* Familiarity with CUDA or GPU image processing and zero-copy image transport between processes
* Background in multi-camera synchronization, stereo rectification, or camera-IMU time alignment

**What does a successful 1X Team Member look like**

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it's the one thing you can't get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

$230K - $285K Base + Equity

**Benefits**

**About the Role**  
  
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multidisciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.  
  
Our AV Labs Hardware team is pioneering the next-generation E/E architecture for our cutting-edge L4 data collection vehicle fleet. As a Staff Electrical Engineer, you will provide deep technical leadership in the design, development, integration, and validation of complex electrical hardware supporting high-performance compute, storage, sensors, networking, power distribution, and vehicle interfaces.  
  
You will own technically challenging hardware designs from concept through production, solve complex electrical problems across board and system boundaries, and establish design practices that enable robust and scalable hardware development. This is a highly hands-on technical leadership role where you will remain deeply involved in circuit design, schematic and PCB reviews, prototype bring-up, laboratory characterization, debugging, and design validation while mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across the hardware team.  
  
**What You Will Do**  

* **Lead Electrical Architecture & Hardware Design:** Architect and develop complex PCB and electrical subsystem designs for high-performance compute, storage, sensor interfaces, networking, power distribution, and vehicle electronics. Own critical design decisions, component selection, circuit analysis, schematic development, and PCB design reviews from concept through production release.
* **Drive Power, High-Speed & SI/PI Design:** Lead technically challenging designs involving high-current and multi-rail power architectures, high-speed digital interfaces, Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), grounding, and EMI/EMC. Perform and guide design analysis, simulation, component derating, tolerance analysis, and worst-case analysis to ensure robust performance across automotive operating conditions.
* **Lead Hardware Bring-Up, Debug & Validation:** Lead bring-up and characterization of complex prototype hardware and develop validation strategies for critical designs. Drive root-cause analysis of difficult circuit, power, signal integrity, EMI/EMC, thermal, and system-level failures using advanced laboratory measurement and debugging techniques.
* **Drive Cross-Functional Vehicle Integration:** Partner with cross functional hardware, firmware and software teams to define interfaces and resolve system-level dependencies. Drive technical alignment across teams and ensure electrical hardware and interfaces meet vehicle performance, reliability, serviceability, and integration requirements.
* **Lead Technical Execution & Production Readiness:** Provide technical leadership from prototype through production release, including architecture reviews, design reviews, component and supplier strategy, DFM/DFA, DFMEA, engineering changes, and validation readiness. Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar for the team, and partner with suppliers and manufacturing teams to deliver robust, scalable hardware.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 8+ years of professional experience designing and developing complex electrical hardware. Demonstrated track record of independently leading technically challenging board-level or electrical subsystem designs from concept through prototype, validation, and production.
* **Electrical Hardware Design Expertise:** Deep understanding of analog, digital, and power electronics with extensive hands-on experience in schematic design, component selection, PCB development, and hardware validation. Strong experience designing complex power architectures, DC/DC converters, power distribution and protection circuits, and high-speed digital interfaces.
* **Technical Leadership & Hardware Development:** Deep hands-on expertise in hardware bring-up, electrical characterization, and root-cause analysis using oscilloscopes, electronic loads, power supplies, current and differential probes, network analyzers, and other advanced laboratory equipment. Proven ability to solve complex multidisciplinary hardware problems and provide technical direction and mentorship to other engineers.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* **Advanced Compute & Automotive Hardware:** Proven experience developing high-performance compute, storage, sensor, networking, or power electronics hardware for autonomous vehicles, automotive, robotics, aerospace, or other demanding embedded systems. Experience with automotive 12 V and/or 48 V power architectures, automotive-grade components, transient protection, and harsh electrical environments.
* **Power, High-Speed, SI/PI & EMI/EMC Expertise:** Extensive experience with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, Automotive Ethernet, GMSL/FPD-Link, USB, DDR, or similar technologies. Strong expertise in Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, stack-up and PCB routing strategy, grounding, shielding, filtering, and board/system-level EMI/EMC mitigation.
* **Hardware Validation & Reliability:** Experience defining and executing comprehensive Design Validation Plans covering electrical performance, power integrity, thermal performance, fault behavior, high-speed interfaces, environmental conditions, and EMI/EMC. Familiarity with automotive standards and test methods such as CISPR 25, ISO 16750, LV124, and related standards, along with DFMEA, DFM/DFA, component derating, tolerance analysis, and worst-case circuit analysis.

MaxLinear is seeking Senior Principal DSP Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following:

Compensation and Benefits:

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $174,000 to $213,000 Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

Company Overview:

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

Responsibilities:

MaxLinear is seeking Principal DSP Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following:

  

* Drive the design, development, validation, and performance optimization of firmware for optical connectivity ASIC (PAM4 DSP) powering AI scale-up and scale-out architectures
* Define and drive software-hardware co-design strategies
* Drive pre-silicon software development, validation, and integration activities
* Lead post-silicon bring-up, performance characterization, debugging, and software optimization across hardware and software boundaries
* Ensure compliance with evolving industry standards and interoperability requirements, including CMIS, OIF, IEEE 802.3, and related optical networking specifications
* Collaborating with ASIC, Communications Systems, and Systems Engineering teams to deliver highly optimized end-to-end solutions
* Partners with customers, field engineering teams, and product management to solve challenging deployment issues
* Mentor engineers across the team and provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews

Qualifications:

* Strong understanding of digital signal processing concepts and implementation techniques
* Proven experience architecting and delivering multiple DSP centric embedded products from concept through production deployment
* Strong software-hardware co-design experience and ability to drive architecture decisions across firmware and ASIC boundaries
* Deep expertise in embedded firmware development using C and embedded operating systems (RTOS)
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
* Experience developing software for high-speed communication, networking, optical, or data center infrastructure products
* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related + 9 years of experience, or MS + 7 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 4 years of experience

Compensation and Benefits:

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $153,000 to $203,000 Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Company Overview:

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Constellation is creating the AI-human translation layer that ensures humanity evolves alongside our technology. Our mission is to leverage AI towards addressing deep and meaningful problems at the core of the human experience: empowering people towards their goals, augmenting our cognition and emotional wellness, and understanding ourselves and each other. Our path forward is to move away from AI that captures human knowledge towards AI that truly understands what it is to be human. We are generating the richest multimodal dataset ever collected to build a new class of foundation models and we're seeking the founding team of engineers to build the infrastructure that makes this ambitious future a reality.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to own the hardware behind our data collection. Our multimodal collection rigs combine biosensors with video and audio capture, and every stream has to stay synchronized and running, session after session. Your job is to keep that growing fleet of rigs synchronized, healthy, and repeatable, and to build the custom hardware and firmware that make it work better.

This is a generalist role on a small founding team, spanning analog electronics, embedded firmware, and the software glue between devices and our data pipeline. It's research hardware, not volume manufacturing: we move quickly to answer questions, then make what works reliable enough to run every day. You'll work closely with our data collection team, software engineers, neuroscientists, and researchers.

We're hiring at multiple levels and will set title and scope to your experience.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Keep our fleet of collection rigs synchronized and healthy: integrate and maintain off-the-shelf devices, such as biosensors, cameras, and audio equipment, and diagnose failures quickly.
* Own time synchronization across every device and data stream.
* Build reliable, documented rigs, test fixtures, and automated validation that let researchers focus on the science.
* Design and bring up custom boards and sensor integrations where you determine off-the-shelf equipment falls short, from schematic and PCB layout through assembly and testing.
* Write and debug C/C++ firmware for microcontrollers and Python tooling for device control, signal-quality checks, and data validation; work with the Linux drivers on our capture machines.
* Partner with our software team on the interface between devices and our data ingestion infrastructure.
* Handle light mechanical work: enclosures, connectors, mounts, and 3D-printed parts that keep hardware durable and comfortable for participants.
* Decide what to build in-house versus contract out, and manage vendors and contractors when we do.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of experience designing and bringing up electronic hardware, with significant hands-on work in both board design and embedded firmware.
* A track record of building physical things that worked in real use: instruments, devices, or research rigs.
* Able to work independently, make sound technical calls, and explain trade-offs clearly to non-hardware teammates.
* Hands-on experience with biosignals (e.g., EEG, ECG, EMG) or other low-noise measurements, including electrode contact, noise sources, grounding, and shielding.
* Schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium or KiCad, including mixed-signal boards.
* Strong C/C++ skills for writing microcontroller firmware (e.g., on ARM Cortex-M, ideally with an RTOS such as Zephyr or FreeRTOS). Comfortable going below the application layer on Linux to debug device drivers, USB and serial issues, and kernel behavior when hardware misbehaves.
* Python for test scripts, device control, and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience synchronizing data across multiple devices (hardware triggers, shared clocks, timestamping).
* Comfortable at the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Demonstrably adaptable and excited about finding creative solutions to problems nobody has solved before.
* Passionate about positively impacting the well-being of humanity and not just capitalizing on it.
* You thrive in a high-bandwidth, collaborative environment.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience writing Linux kernel modules or device drivers.
* FPGA or HDL experience (e.g., Verilog, VHDL).
* Prior work with research-grade sensing equipment, such as eye trackers or EEG systems, and with synchronization tools such as Lab Streaming Layer (LSL).
* Familiarity with other physiological sensing, such as fNIRS, EDA, or PPG.
* Medical electrical isolation and safety for equipment used with human participants (e.g., IEC 60601).
* A background in designing wearable, battery-powered, or Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.
* Basic mechanical CAD and 3D printing.
* Interest in neurotech, mental health, or human-AI interaction.

**Benefits**
------------

* Comprehensive, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance with premiums fully covered.
* A renovated, light-filled office with a quirky layout in the heart of San Francisco's Mission District, surrounded by world-class food and coffee.
* Relocation assistance for those joining us in SF and workspace setup stipend.
* Monthly team dinners and outings, plus twice-yearly off-sites and retreats.
* Fully stocked kitchen (snacks!)
* Sponsorship for travel to relevant conferences and regular professional development activities to help you level up.
* A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave with a “soft-landing” transition back.
* Paid time off (PTO)

Compensation Range: $180K - $260K

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Fairchild Imaging, headquartered in San Jose, California is a specialty image sensor design and manufacturing company with deep experience in developing leading edge performance CMOS image sensors. Our portfolio of image sensors can be found in many high-performance imaging applications like space exploration, medical x-ray, sciences, quantum computing, machine vision, low light, and 360 situational awareness.

**Senior Hardware Design Engineer – High-Speed Electronics**

  

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Hardware Design Engineer** to lead the design and development of advanced PCB-based electronic systems featuring high-speed digital interfaces, complex multilayer boards, and demanding signal and power integrity requirements.

The role requires deep expertise in high-speed digital hardware design, PCB architecture, signal integrity, power delivery, and system-level optimization. Experience with USB-C interoperability and robust high-bandwidth data interfaces is particularly valuable.

In addition to hands-on engineering, this role may include responsibility for mentoring engineers, driving technical direction across projects, and contributing to team growth and engineering excellence.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership and Team Development**

* Provide technical leadership across hardware development programs.
* Mentor junior and mid-level hardware engineers in schematic design, PCB layout, debugging, and engineering best practices.
* Lead hardware design reviews, architecture discussions, and cross-functional technical decision-making.
* Establish and promote engineering standards for high-speed PCB design, signal integrity, documentation, and validation.
* Support project planning, task prioritization, resource estimation, and execution tracking.
* May directly manage a small team of hardware engineers, including goal setting, performance feedback, career development, coaching, hiring, and onboarding.

**High-Speed Hardware Architecture and Design**

* Architect, design, and validate complex multilayer PCBs for high-performance electronic systems.
* Define board-level architectures, component selection, schematics, layout constraints, and interconnect strategies.
* Design and validate high-speed interfaces, including:

* + USB-C and USB high-speed data interfaces
  + LVDS and other high-speed serial interfaces
  + High-speed differential links and memory interfaces

* Collaborate with firmware, software, systems, and other engineering teams to ensure robust system integration.
* Optimize board architecture, power delivery, grounding, clocking, and layout to meet performance, reliability, and noise requirements.
* Evaluate and mitigate hardware design impacts on system performance, including timing errors, electrical noise, EMI/EMC coupling, and power integrity artifacts.

  

**USB-C Interoperability and System Integration**

* Design and debug robust USB-C implementations, including:

* + Connector orientation and configuration support
  + Enumeration and connection reliability
  + Sustained high-bandwidth data streaming
  + Cable, host, and hub interoperability
  + Power sequencing and interface robustness

* Diagnose intermittent hardware and interface failures through systematic testing, measurement, and root-cause analysis.
* Analyze and resolve signal integrity and power integrity challenges across USB-C and other high-speed interfaces.
* Work with firmware and software teams to distinguish hardware, firmware, and system-level failure modes.

  

**Signal Integrity and Hardware Excellence**

* Serve as a technical authority in high-speed and high-density PCB design.
* Apply and guide best practices for:

* + Signal integrity analysis and validation
  + Impedance control and stackup design
  + Differential-pair routing and skew management
  + Return-path continuity and via transitions
  + Crosstalk and insertion-loss mitigation
  + Power integrity and low-noise supply design

* Drive schematic reviews, layout reviews, design-for-test considerations, and hardware validation plans.
* Lead prototype bring-up, lab debugging, failure analysis, and design iteration.
* Document design decisions, test results, and corrective actions to support reliable product development and production readiness.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* BS/MS in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* 8+ years of hardware design experience, including complex multilayer PCB design.
* Proven expertise designing high-speed digital systems and high-density PCBs.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, or team lead experience.
* Strong working knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, and high-speed layout constraints.
* Practical experience with high-speed interfaces such as USB-C, USB, LVDS, or other high-speed serial and differential interfaces.
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as **Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro**, or equivalent.
* Hands-on lab debugging skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and related instrumentation.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex hardware issues, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions.
* Strong technical communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, LiDAR Characterization
jobs.description:
Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva is transforming autonomy with its groundbreaking sensing and perception technology that integrates all key LiDAR components onto a silicon photonics chip in a compact module. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions.

### **Role Overview**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer, LiDAR Characterization, to join the Systems team and work hands-on with our next-generation 4D LiDAR sensors. This role is for someone who wants to spend most of their time on the sensor itself: running it in the lab and in the field, measuring how it performs, and working out why it behaves the way it does.

You will characterize sensor performance across a wide range of scenarios, debug system-level issues, and support sensor calibration. You will work closely with senior systems engineers and with the algorithms, firmware, hardware, and optics teams, and you will build a working understanding of the full sensor, from the photonics and electronics through signal processing to the point cloud.

### **What you'll do**

* Set up and run tests on LiDAR sensors in the lab and on vehicles for comprehensive characterization
* Develop automation software to accelerate lab testing and data collection
* Support field data collection across real-world scenarios, including preparing sensors and test setups and logging test conditions.
* Investigate system-level issues: reproduce the problem, collect diagnostic data, and work with the relevant engineering teams to find the root cause.
* Help develop, run, and verify sensor calibration procedures.
* Analyze sensor data with Python or MATLAB, and document and present results to the Systems team and cross-functional partners.

### **What you'll have**

* An MS in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics/Photonics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, with 0–2 years of industry experience.
* Hands-on lab experience with sensors, optical systems, or electronic test equipment from research, internships, or industry.
* Proficiency in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, and a foundation in signal processing, optics, or measurement statistics.
* A methodical approach to debugging problems that span hardware, firmware, and software, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience with LiDAR, radar, or other perception sensors, FMCW or coherent detection, or sensor calibration is a plus.

### **What's in it for you**

* Spend most of your time hands-on with a cutting-edge 4D LiDAR sensor and learn the full system end to end.
* Work alongside and be mentored by experienced systems, optics, and signal processing engineers.
* Be part of a fast-paced and dynamic team.

$110,000 - $149,153 a year

**Description**

  
  

WORK LOCATION: San Luis Obispo, CA

FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt

SALARY RANGE: The anticipated salary range for this role is $25 to $42 per hour. This range reflects a good faith estimate based on the targeted level for the role and typical compensation benchmarks across U.S. locations. Actual compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographical location, and internal alignment.

SUMMARY

The Engineering Specialist, Electrical is a hands-on technical role responsible for executing electrical assembly, wiring, and test activities for unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). This role builds on foundational electrical skills and expands into more complex harness builds, subsystem integration, electrical troubleshooting, and execution of electrical test procedures with minimal supervision.

The Electrical Specialist II supports prototype development, test articles, and low-rate production hardware, identifies and resolves routine electrical issues, and partners with engineers to improve build quality, reliability, and electrical integration processes. This role represents a fully contributing technical specialist progressing toward senior-level electrical authority.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The following job functions are a basic requirement but are not limited to and may be assigned other duties.

* Build and install electrical assemblies, wire harnesses, and cable assemblies for UAS platforms.
* Perform electrical integration activities, including routing, securing, and terminating wiring within airframes and subsystems.
* Execute electrical test procedures independently, including continuity checks, insulation resistance tests, and power-on verification.
* Troubleshoot and resolve routine electrical issues such as wiring errors, connector faults, grounding problems, or intermittent signals.
* Support board-level bring-up activities under engineering guidance.
* Read, interpret, and apply electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation.
* Perform rework, modifications, and repairs on electrical assemblies in accordance with procedures.
* Document build steps, test results, discrepancies, and corrective actions.
* Maintain ESD compliance, tool control, and organized electrical workspaces.
* Collaborate with electrical engineers, mechanical specialists, and production teams to improve electrical integration and build processes.
* Assumes all other responsibilities as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Technical coursework or certification in electrical technology, electronics, avionics, or a related field preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Secure Systems
jobs.description:
**GROW WITH US AND STAY EXTRAORDINARY:**  
Launch your career to new heights with Innoflight—one of San Diego’s fastest-growing Aerospace and Defense innovators. Here, visionary minds engineer the future of space technology through pioneering, compact, and cyber-secure solutions. From software-defined radios to cutting-edge cryptographic systems and avionics, everything we build powers the next era of New Space. Join our small, agile, and mission-driven team where your work has real impact and your growth has no limits. We’re not just reaching for the stars—we’re engineering them. Let’s innovate the infinite, together.  
  
**A DAY IN THE LIFE:**  
As a **Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Cyber (secure systems),** you will design, develop, and integrate advanced cyber secure embedded software solutions for satellite avionics and payload data processing systems. You will collaborate closely with Systems, Hardware, and FPGA engineers to deliver highly secure, rugged, reliable, and Low-Size, Weight, and Power (Low-SWaP) aerospace products. You will also provide technical mentorship and Subject Matter Expert (SME) level guidance to development and test teams.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Design and Develop Embedded Software:** Design and implement embedded software for multi-core processors integrated with FPGAs (e.g., Xilinx, Microsemi, Microchip, Vorago).
* **Develop for Processor Architectures:** Create software for ARM Cortex and RISC-V processor architectures using C/C++.
* **Configure Linux and RTOS Systems:** Customize Linux kernel, system settings, bootloaders (U-Boot, GRUB), and implement real-time operating systems (RTOS).
* **Implement Secure Networking Protocols:** Develop RFC-compliant networking and security protocols such as IP, TLS, and IPsec.
* **Integrate Hardware Interfaces:** Work with interconnect standards including SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, PCI, PCIe, Ethernet, and SpaceWire.
* **Apply Cryptographic Systems:** Utilize AES, RSA, ECDSA, and ECDH to develop secure software solutions.
* **Lead Software Development and Testing:** Oversee the development and testing of reusable, high-quality embedded software modules.
* **Ensure Secure System Best Practices:** Establish best practices in Architecture, Design, and Code to maintain system security.
* **Translate Complex Requirements:** Convert system and customer requirements into robust software designs.
* **Interpret Government Security Standards:** Apply government security standards relevant to Innoflight product design and development.
* **Support Software-Hardware Integration:** Assist with integration and debugging on hardware platforms.
* **Manage Software Configuration:** Track features, defects, and releases via formal configuration and release processes.
* **Drive Continuous Improvement:** Contribute to the enhancement of development practices and team workflows.
* **Mentor Junior Engineers:** Provide mentorship through design reviews, code walkthroughs, and technical guidance.

**YOU’RE AWESOME AT:**

* **Embedded Software Development:** Expert in C/C++ for embedded systems and low-level driver development.
* **Linux and RTOS Configuration:** Skilled in embedded Linux kernel, bootloader customization, and real-time OS development.
* **Secure Communication & Hardware Integration:** Experienced with secure networking protocols and hardware interfaces like SPI, PCIe, and Ethernet.
* **Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to mentor junior engineers and lead software development teams effectively.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 9+ years of experience developing embedded software.
* Advanced proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems.
* Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, kernel configuration, and bootloaders.
* Strong understanding of RTOS and real-time constraints.
* Experience interpreting schematics and hardware documentation for driver development.
* Proficient in networking and communications protocols with secure communication standards.
* Familiarity with cryptographic principles and embedded security applications.
* Experience in software integration, debugging, and system-level validation.
* Familiarity with parallel-processing frameworks such as OpenCL or CUDA is a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Proven mentoring and collaborative skills.
* Active U.S. Security Clearance required.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**  
The starting base salary for this position ranges from **$170,000 to $215,000 per year**, depending on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, Innoflight offers a well-rounded compensation package that includes a Profit-Sharing Bonus and a Cash Performance Bonus to reward both individual and company performance. Additional benefits include:

* 401(k) with 3% company match (automatic enrollment)
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, HSA & life insurance
* 10 paid holidays + 120 hours PTO (starting in year one)
* Access to ancillary benefits such as critical illness, accident, disability, legal and pet insurance.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:**

* **Flexible Work-Life Balance:** Enjoy a 9/80 work schedule with every other Friday off—whether you use it to recharge, work on a passion project, or spend time with family, the choice is yours.
* **Continuous Learning & Development:** We’re serious about professional development. From tuition reimbursement to internal "Ask Me Anything" sessions and weekly “Lunch & Learns,” we make learning a core part of the job.
* **Mission-Driven Culture:** We aren’t just building tech—we’re enabling the next era of space exploration. Our Culture Ambassadors help lead initiatives around inclusion, positivity, recognition, and transparency. Here, your voice is heard, your work is respected, and your individuality is celebrated.

**BE YOU, WITH US:**  
At Innoflight

jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Safety
jobs.description:
**About Mytra:**

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

**About the role**
------------------

As an Automation Engineer at Mytra, you will join our Systems Engineering team during a period of rapid product development and scaling. Our team is focused on building the control, safety, and electrical infrastructure that ensures safe operation of the Mytra system. We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented integration engineer who brings deep experience with traditional industrial automation while also understanding modern embedded systems and software. You will help us deliver robust systems today using proven off-the-shelf industrial hardware while contributing to our longer-term roadmap toward a more modern embedded hardware and software architecture. You will design, integrate, and debug safety- and mission-critical systems that must be robust, diagnosable, and maintainable. You will also help determine the right balance between commercial industrial automation components and custom hardware developed internally.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Develop and maintain PLC-based control and safety systems, including distributed I/O, industrial networks, and interfaces to mobile and stationary automation equipment.
* Design high-voltage and low-voltage electrical panels and control cabinets using ePLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar tools.
* Work closely with **Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Firmware, and Software teams** to define clear interfaces and develop features that integrate mechanical, electrical, and software capabilities.
* Develop specialized service and commissioning tools, such as jog pendants, and scalable control and safety architectures for site deployments that push the limits of conventional industrial automation.
* Troubleshoot complex electromechanical systems across **electrical, controls, embedded, networking, and software boundaries.**
* Support system integration, commissioning, testing, and root-cause investigations in Mytra facilities and, occasionally, at customer sites.

**Ideal Candidates**
--------------------

* Significant hands-on experience designing, commissioning, and troubleshooting industrial control systems using Beckhoff TwinCAT/TwinSAFE, Siemens controllers and Siemens Safety, or comparable PLC and safety platforms.
* Experience designing electrical control systems and panels using ePLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of industrial controls hardware, sensors, actuators, safety devices, distributed I/O, and safety communications across distributed equipment.
* Experience developing **safety- and mission-critical systems**, with an emphasis on reliability, diagnosability, fault handling, and maintainability.
* Clear communication of complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience transitioning products from one to many, including developing training and documentation for manufacturing and commissioning teams.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, recognize when an approach is not working, pivot based on data and engineering evidence, and drive projects to completion.
* Ability to travel domestically on occasion, approximately 0–10% annually, to support integration, commissioning, and testing at customer sites.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Familiarity with functional safety principles (e.g., HARA, FMEA, and HAZOP) and safety standards (e.g., ISO 13849, IEC 61508, and ISO 12100).
* Experience designing or integrating embedded control hardware, custom PCBAs, or microcontroller-based systems, and evaluating when custom hardware is preferable to an off-the-shelf industrial controller.
* Experience writing and debugging **C++ and/or Python**.
* Enthusiasm for **modernizing industrial automation** and replacing legacy approaches with better hardware, software, development, and debugging tools.
* Experience integrating controls for **robotics, autonomous systems, material handling, warehouse automation, or similar complex electromechanical equipment.**

**A Final Note:**
-----------------

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last

**Benefits Include:**
---------------------

* Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high-growth company backed by top-tier VCs
* Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents
* 401(k) plans and employer-subsidized life insurance
* Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table
* Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together
* Voluntary pet insurance, life insurance, accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity coverage
* Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity
* Commuter benefits, including up to a $150 monthly commuter benefit
* Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases
* Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters
