jobs.description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Power Electronics Engineer**

  

Analog Devices is committed to investing in our people and their growth. Our hiring program features high-impact professional development, opportunities to drive meaningful projects that are directly tied to business goals, and unique executive exposure. Our duty is to develop the next generation of talent in our communities and provide them with a pathway to apply their academic skills in the real world. At ADI, our hires will learn from the brightest minds who are dedicated to their growth, development, and success. From an industry perspective, incoming new career hires are surrounded by employees who represent the best minds in their respective fields.

  
  

The ADI Power uModule Team is seeking a motivated Power Electronics Engineer to work fully onsite and characterize and qualify DC-DC converters, power modules, and semiconductor devices through hands-on laboratory testing. Training and engineering guidance are provided.

  
  

The role combines product measurements, test-hardware integration, troubleshooting, data review, and safe laboratory operation.

  
  

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* **Characterize power hardware:** Test DC-DC converters, power modules, and semiconductor devices using power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, current probes, and temperature measurements.
* **Evaluate performance:** Interpret switching waveforms, voltage and current behavior, efficiency, transient response, regulation, and temperature; identify product, measurement, or setup issues.
* **Develop test setups:** Select measurement methods and adapt fixtures, wiring, sensing, and instrumentation for new product requirements.
* **Support qualification:** Run electrical and thermal derating and automated power-cycling tests; verify conditions, monitor tests, investigate anomalies, troubleshoot hardware, and document results.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Knowledge of switching converters, electrical measurements, transient behavior, and thermal performance.
* Hands-on experience with power-electronics hardware and instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, probes, sensors, or data acquisition equipment. Relevant academic, project, internship, or professional experience may qualify.
* Ability to read schematics, assemble or modify test hardware, interpret measurements, and troubleshoot product behavior and test setups during late-stage bring-up.
* Ability to analyze results, document findings, and communicate clearly.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience testing power semiconductor devices, DC-DC converters, power modules, or uModule products.
* Experience monitoring extended automated characterization or qualification tests.
* Familiarity with Allegro, Altium Designer, or similar PCB tools for new or modified test hardware.
* Experience designing test fixtures, wiring harnesses, or custom hardware interfaces.
* Familiarity with automated test equipment and data acquisition systems.
* Knowledge of thermal management, environmental testing, or reliability laboratory practices.
  

  

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**

The successful candidate is curious, dependable, and comfortable working with power-conversion hardware. They connect measurements to circuit behavior, troubleshoot methodically, ask questions when needed, and gradually take ownership of assigned tests and hardware while collaborating on new technical challenges.

jobs.title: HPC Systems Engineer

Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

Anduril is seeking a High Performance Computing (HPC) System Engineer to directly support our most sensitive programs. You will be a part of the team building and maintaining large scale HPC infrastructure. You will have the opportunity to work with and learn from some of the world's best engineers and cybersecurity professionals as you help to implement cutting edge systems. You will work directly to support systems deployed across the globe in support of national security missions.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment supporting high-profile operational and research requirements.
* Architect and deploy advanced GPU infrastructure, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of cutting-edge NVIDIA hardware including H100, H200, and B200/B300 systems.
* Ability to rack, stack, cable, and configure physical servers and multi-node GPU systems from end to end.
* Configure HPC and AI environments, including job schedulers (e.g., Slurm), multi-user login environments, and cluster management software (e.g., Warewulf, NVIDIA Base Command, RunAI).

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, Performance Modeling
jobs.description:
**Normal Computing | Build with Us**
------------------------------------

Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), London, Copenhagen, and Seoul.

**The Role**
------------

As a Performance Modeling Engineer at Normal, you will build the transaction-level model (TLM) of our physics-inspired ASICs. It is the model that sits between RTL and the rest of our modeling stack, and that both our architects and our verification team rely on.

You will own the path from RTL to the numerical performance results. You will correlate the TLM against RTL, FPGA prototypes, and synthesis results, then turn it into calibrated latency, bandwidth and energy parameters for kernel-level models. You will work closely with the architecture, hardware design and DV teams, using their feedback to help refine our end-to-end system.

The through-line is your modeling expertise, applied to an architecture that computes differently from anything you have modeled before, and to the AI that is changing how AI workloads get done. This is a seat for a performance modeling engineer who wants their craft to compound rather than repeat. Ultimately Normal Computing will build a next generation system with 100-1000× improvement in AI inference, and your work will make this possible.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

* **Transaction-Level Model:** Build and maintain a cycle-accurate approximate TLM of our compute tiles, memory hierarchy, and interconnect in an appropriate language (SystemC, C++ or Python). The code must be fast enough to simulate real workloads and accurate enough to make production design decisions
* **Feeding the Modeling Stack**: Translate TLM and RTL results combined with physical design into calibrated parameters (latency, bandwidth, energy, utilization, occupancy, etc.) to enable end-to-end system level performance prediction on AI workloads
* **Verification Reference:** Provide the TLM as a reference “golden model” for DV, including transaction level scoreboards and performance checks and work with the DV and RTL team to ensure RTL produces the desired end-target behavior so that the TLM reflects the RTL and the RTL reflects the TLM.
* **Planning and Performance Feedback:** Plan modeling work against the hardware roadmap and run sensitivity studies on key hardware parameters (buffer sizes, interface widths, scheduling policies, and bus configurations) to turn results into clear recommendations for the architecture and hardware teams

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in performance modeling at a major semiconductor company
* Demonstrated proficiency in understanding architectures and transforming that to performant modeling code
* Use of various modeling techniques and languages
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience with AI acceleration hardware
* Experience with architecture-level modeling and cost tools such as AccelForge, Timeloop/Accelergy, CACTI, McPAT, or gem5
* Experience with DV methodology
* Hands-on use of LLMs or agentic tools in development workflows
* Exposure to analog, mixed-signal, or unconventional compute
* Experience with memory interfaces (LPDDR, HBM, DDR) and other I/O

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Private Cloud Compute Inference Routing
jobs.description:
Apple is looking for a senior software engineer to build the next generation of inference routing for Private Cloud Compute, the backbone of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence. You'll design distributed systems that direct inference requests across a global fleet of inference servers, balancing latency, availability, and compute efficiency while preserving PCC's privacy guarantees. Your work will directly shape how reliably and efficiently Apple delivers cloud inference at scale.  
  
You'll join iCloud Platform Engineering team. We build the server stack behind Push Notifications, iMessage, FaceTime, iCloud, iCloud Private Relay and Private Cloud Compute. Our internet scale distributed systems deliver real-time experiences with very low latency and very high availability. They reach hundreds of millions of users across a billion devices worldwide and help them connect and share their lives securely and privately. Our work spans identity, messaging, queueing, presence, routing, relays, developer APIs and much more. We're a small, highly collaborative team with a large impact.  
  
**Description**  
  
Routing LLM inference at Apple's scale requires systems that adapt to changing demand, available capacity, and failures while maintaining low latency and high utilization. PCC adds a fundamental architectural requirement: request content remains encrypted outside trusted compute nodes. You'll develop routing and scheduling strategies within this privacy model, working with inference and security teams to evaluate techniques such as cache aware request placement and prefill/decode disaggregation.  
  
You'll design system architectures, specify custom network protocols and write high performance code. You'll also build scaling strategies for services used by hundreds of millions of people. Our team is small and highly visible, so your chances to make an impact are wide open. If you take opportunities like that and run with them, you'll enjoy working here.  
  
You'll own technical decisions from early design through production, using benchmarks and operational evidence to evaluate tradeoffs. You'll work closely with model serving, infrastructure, security, and SRE engineers to turn new inference requirements into reliable routing capabilities.","responsibilities":"Design, build, and operate PCC's inference routing and request scheduling services, including global traffic management, capacity aware request placement, load balancing, and failover.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience leading projects.
* 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience architecting complex client-to-cloud telemetry systems, CUJ monitoring frameworks, or semantic quality evaluation pipelines.
* Expertise in ML model serving infrastructure, real-time low-latency streaming systems, or distributed IoT communication protocols.
* Track record of driving cross-functional architectural alignment and influencing technical decisions across large engineering organizations.

**About the job**
-----------------

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Home SRE engineers the reliability, performance, and scalability behind Google Home, powering ambient experiences across more than 100 million connected devices worldwide. Google Home is in the midst of rapid product evolution and high momentum, driven by major software breakthroughs like Gemini for Home alongside a continuous pipeline of recent and upcoming hardware launches.

Our team operates at the unique intersection of physical hardware, distributed cloud infrastructure, and next-generation real-time Voice AI. We focus on high-leverage architectural engagements—partnering closely with development teams to simplify core backends, optimize ML serving, and ensure smart home interactions are instant, reliable, and trustworthy.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement.
* Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
* Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Define the technical outlook, architectural roadmap, and reliability strategy for Home SRE.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer-IT Stf.
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**WHAT WE’RE DOING**

Do you want to be part of a culture that inspires employees to innovate, perform with excellence, and build incredible products? If you have the passion, drive, and courage to dream big, we want you to help build a better tomorrow. Lockheed Martin’s Rotary & Mission Systems team is seeking an experienced System Engineer – IT to support the Peace Krypton (PK) program.

**THE WORK**

As a System Engineer – IT you will:

* Perform technical planning and analysis for the total system.
* Lead system integration, verification, and validation activities, while ensuring conversion of customer and product requirements into system solutions that respect technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
* Design, develop, and analyze IT solutions – create and validate computer system architectures, software programs, and related IT components based on user or system design specifications; consult with users to determine hardware, software, or functional specifications.
* Build and deploy mission critical IT infrastructure – design and install Windows‑based virtualization (VMware vSphere/vCenter), storage (VEEAM, GoodSync), and Active Directory forests/domains; configure networking, IP‑addressing, VLANs, and firewall interfaces; implement DISA‑STIG hardening and ensure compliance with security baselines.
* Produce integration documentation – generate network diagrams, VLAN/IP matrices, rack‑plan layouts, configuration‑baseline documents, and systems‑integration artifacts for the left‑hand side of the Systems Engineering “V”.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams – work with software, hardware, test, and test‑and‑evaluation engineers, as well as customers and stakeholders, to assure seamless system integration and readiness for field deployment.
* Execute functional and performance testing – develop test plans, conduct testing, analyze results, and certify system readiness for deployment.
* Provide technical leadership – mentor junior engineers and drive process improvements.

**WHO WE ARE**

We empower a diverse, geographically dispersed team of technical professionals—including software developers, aircraft and hardware engineers, and integration & test engineers—to deliver mission‑focused solutions in a highly dynamic environment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* An experienced System Engineer – IT with deep expertise in the left‑hand side of the Systems Engineering “V” and hands‑on system‑integration responsibilities.
* Proven ability to perform technical planning, system integration, verification, validation, cost, risk, and supportability analyses for complex, multi‑site ground‑and‑air systems.
* Skilled at designing, developing, and analyzing computer systems or programs based on user or system design specifications, consulting with users to determine hardware, software, or functional specifications.
* Strong background in requirements development, functional/timeline analysis, trade studies, requirements allocation, and interface definition to translate customer needs into hardware and software specifications.
* Proficient with Windows OS, virtualization (VMware vSphere), storage solutions, enterprise networking, and security hardening (DISA STIGs).
* Able to generate comprehensive integration artifacts, build procedures, and documentation that span concept through disposal.
* Excellent communicator and collaborator.

**WHY JOIN US**

You will work on a high‑impact program with a supportive culture that values work‑life balance, flexible scheduling, competitive compensation, and comprehensive benefits.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related STEM field.
* Minimum 10 years of systems engineering experience or 7 years with a master's degree, with a focus on requirements development, system design, and IT system integration through critical milestones (SRR/SDR, PDR, CDR, TRR).
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem‑solving skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, complete documentation.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* CompTIA Security+ certification (or equivalent).
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Knowledge of industry standards/regulations (ISO 15288, IEEE 1220, DO‑178C).
* Experience with DOORS Next (or equivalent requirements management tools).
* Strong scripting/programming abilities (C#, PowerShell).
* Experience with DISA STIGs, IT Management Suite (ITMS), and virtual/converged systems.
* Hands‑on experience configuring and deploying VMware vSphere, VEEAM, GoodSync, and related COTS products.
* Familiarity with Active Directory, Windows Server, VDI, and enterprise storage/backup solutions.

Full-Time Salary Range: $104900.00 - $194700.00

To strengthen our Global Operations Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) team, we are looking for an **MSAT Engineer (Electrical Engineering / Test Engineering)** responsible for optimized design and manufacturing of electronics and mechatronics assemblies, modules, and complete products.

In this role, you will act as the technical liaison between R&D, Quality and Manufacturing, translating product innovation into scalable, high-performance manufacturing solutions for Agilent’s analytical instrumentation platforms at the Little Falls, Delaware (Wilmington) site, and also remotely support instrument-products at Agilent's Chicopee Massachusetts and Winooski Vermont sites. You will contribute to process industrialization, technology transfer, and platform standardization, while working in a global, cross-functional environment.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership & Industrialization**

  

* Key focus on production test planning for new products, but also contribute to evaluation of electronics designs, complex qualifications, and root cause analyses during the NPI phase.
* Ensure application of Design-for-Excellence (DfX) across cost, manufacturability, quality, and automation.
* Collaborate with R&D on product development, validation, and manufacturability readiness.
* Influence design to ensure scalability, supply chain and process robustness, and manufacturability.
* Define system-level manufacturing concepts, test strategies, and industrialization approach.
* Lead prototype ramp, reliability validation, and evaluate launch readiness.

* Ensures Value Creation across cost, quality, reliability, delivery, supply robustness, and global product engineering strategy.
* Lead root cause investigations and systemic corrective actions for complex & cross-functional technical issues escalated from the factory team.

* 5+ years of engineering experience supporting, the production of life science/biotechnology equipment or other complex instruments.
* Hands-on experience with manufacturing equipment, instrumentation, electrical systems, and production support.
* Experience developing, implementing, and qualifying production test plans, test procedures, and test systems.
* Software programming experience related to manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, data acquisition, or test systems (e.g., PLC programming, Python, Java, Arduino, C#, SQL, or similar).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That's how we help brands exceed customer expectations.

  

We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry's most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.

  

AutoStore – moving things forward.

  
  

**The Role:**

  

AutoStore is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and ship the software that connects and runs our automated storage and fulfillment systems. You will work across the stack, from networked services and messaging to the pipelines that build, test, and secure our code.

We are looking for an engineer with 5–7 years of professional software development experience who has owned features from design through to production. You write solid code in one or more of Rust, C++, Java, Python, or TypeScript, understand how systems communicate across networks and firewalls, and bring hands-on DevOps experience so that your software is built, tested, and scanned automatically. Our team works in GitHub.

As a senior member of the team, you will help set technical direction, review designs and code, and mentor other engineers. This role includes domestic and international travel.

  

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

  

**Software Design and Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain software in one or more of Rust, C++, Java, Python, or TypeScript.
* Build services and integrations that communicate using messaging and API technologies such as MQTT, RabbitMQ, REST, and WebSockets.
* Make sound architecture and design decisions that balance performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
Write unit and integration tests, and debug complex issues across the application, operating system, and network layers.  

  

**Networking and Connectivity**

* Design and support network communication between our software, devices, cloud services, and customer systems.
* Configure firewall rules and network settings so that systems can communicate securely across firewalls and network boundaries.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues such as blocked ports, latency, dropped connections, and certificate or TLS problems.  

  

**Containers and Platform**

* Package, run, and troubleshoot applications in Docker containers.
* Apply a solid understanding of operating system concepts to build efficient, reliable software.
Deploy and operate services in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS where needed.  

  

**CI/CD and DevOps**

* Set up and maintain build pipelines in GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Automate test runs as soon as a build is ready, and publish the results where the team can see them.
* Integrate automated cybersecurity scans and static code analysis into the pipeline.
Debug, triage, and resolve pipeline failures.  

  

**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Review designs and code, and help raise the quality bar of the whole team.
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers.
* Work within cross-functional teams, collaborating with hardware, firmware, QA, and product colleagues.
* Document designs, interfaces, and processes so others can use and support them.
Travel domestically and internationally as needed, for example to customer sites, partners, and other AutoStore locations.  

  
  

**Key Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5–7 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong programming skills in one or more of the following: Rust, C++, Java, Python, or TypeScript.
* Experience with one or more of the following messaging and communication technologies: MQTT, RabbitMQ, REST APIs, or WebSockets.
* Hands-on experience developing and running applications in Docker.
* A good understanding of operating system concepts, such as processes, threads, memory management, file systems, and scheduling.
* Experience with computer networking, including TCP/IP, configuring firewalls, and enabling secure communication between systems across firewalls and network boundaries (e.g., port and protocol configuration, NAT, VPNs, and proxies).
* DevOps experience setting up build pipelines, including automated build testing, cybersecurity scanning, and static code analysis.
* Strong Git skills and experience working in GitHub.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.  

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience with GitHub Actions specifically.
* Experience with security and code-quality tools such as SonarQube, CodeQL, Snyk, or Trivy.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Helm.
* Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or Ansible.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* Experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, or Weights & Biases, and an understanding of the ML lifecycle.
Exposure to embedded systems, robotics, or industrial automation.  

  
  

**We Offer:**

AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere.

  

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution
* Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents

In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print

‑and apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities.

* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

\*Must flexible with being on-call on weekends as needed\*

* PLC Programming Experience
* SCADA Experience

Machines & technologies you'll use:

* Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Data Center Engineering - Electrical Products and Services (DCE-EPS)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical infrastructure that powers one of the world's largest and most complex networks? Amazon is looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to take on a technical leadership role in the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of our data center infrastructure systems. In this role, you will tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will serve as a key technical resource, guiding infrastructure strategy and influencing decisions that shape the long-term reliability and efficiency of our facilities. If you are a collaborative problem solver who thrives on simplifying complex systems and mentoring others, we want to hear from you.

* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
* Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.

Throughout, you will share your expertise with colleagues, helping to raise the technical bar across the team.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
\*Diverse Experiences\*

This role works with internal teams, practice leaders, construction and low-voltage vendors, application teams, and remote MSP partners to complete infrastructure deployments from site preparation through go-live and ongoing support. jobs.description:
**Company Description**

*Carlisle Companies is a leading manufacturer of building envelope products and solutions that make buildings more energy efficient, durable, and sustainable.*

*We deliver roofing, insulation, waterproofing, and architectural systems for commercial and residential projects using a focus on innovation and continuous improvement to solve today’s challenges.*

*We’re equally committed to our people, prioritizing safety, inclusion, career growth development, tuition assistance, and excellent benefits.*

*With manufacturing, engineering, R&D, and corporate functions across North America and globally, Carlisle offers stability, agility, and opportunity in a performance-driven culture. Do meaningful work and shape the future of building solutions; apply today and come grow with us.*

 **Job Description**

**Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM)** is seeking an experenced **Electrical Engineer** to join our team in **Greenville, IL**. The Electrical Engineer is responsible for handling or supervise those handling specific projects as directed by the Manager of Engineering. Projects include estimating cost design, layout and specs for materials and installation, obtaining bids for equipment and labor, and supervise the complete installation and startup. Projects range from minor modifications to large equipment installations. In addition, the Electrical Engineer will assist maintenance personnel with electrical troubleshooting related to PLC, HMI’s and other higher level electrical devices. This includes accountability for instructing and monitoring safety of all maintenance personnel, specifically with electrical safety programs such as Lockout/Tagout and Arc Flash/Electrical Safety Program.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

The person in this position will be utilized in a wide variety of situations. Regular duties are listed below. The position will be assigned to special projects as the plant identifies new areas in need of improvement. These special projects may be related to Safety, Regulatory, Process Improvement, Facility Improvement, etc.

* Engineering Activities (~70% of Time)
  + Design in-house equipment modifications and new installations to provide increased productivity. This requires electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic knowledge.
  + Troubleshoot maintenance and production problems on equipment to reduce downtime by utilizing technical knowledge, troubleshooting techniques, and available test equipment.
  + Plan, supervise, and communicate modifications to equipment to ensure safety, cost savings, and increase productivity.
  + Prepare sketches for fabrications, modifications, and installation of equipment to ensure the safety and productive operation of said equipment. Define parts, order parts, write reports, communicate project status, and update department project lists and review Maintenance Department’s previous night’s activities.
  + Create new and update old drawings using a CAD system.
* Other Misc. Duties (~30% of Time)
  + Attend and contribute regularly to job related plant initiatives (i.e. Safety, COS, Cost Savings).

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Ability to read and understand the various schematics and electrical prints for the equipment in CCM Greenville
* Ability to program and modify PLCs, VFDs, HMIs and other programmable equipment.
* Understand and adhere to the guidelines of an electrical safety plan based on NFPA, OSHA, NEC, Etc. codes and using it to ensure the safety of yourself and others.
* Proficiency with utilizing a computer, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AutoCAD.
* Ability to access and utilize the software associated with the various VFDs, PLCs, Wonderware, and HMIs utilized throughout CCM Greenville.
* Demonstrate effective communication skills: written, oral, and electronic

**Equipment/Data:**

* Be able to operate electrical troubleshooting equipment, such as a multimeter, megger, oscilloscope, current probe, and computer.
* Be able to understand, modify, train others on PLC, VFD, Safety Controllers, and other electrical control devices.

**Work Environment/Time Worked:**

* Work Environment:
  + Approximately 70% of work time is spent in a climate controlled, relatively clean and quiet office environment. The remaining 30% is spent in a manufacturing plant environment working on projects or inventory related activities. On occasion this person will be required to attend meetings. The job itself can be very stressful at times and can require a fast pace. There will be occasions where machine failures will require intense focus and quick resolution while maintaining a safe work performance. These machine failures can happen at non-traditional work hours. An individual must be able to work on several different projects simultaneously and in order of priority to meet deadlines.
* Time Worked:
  + Core Hours 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM; 40 Hours/Week, Monday through Friday
  + The core hours are required to interface with other daylight departments and support groups. Depending on projects, additional time outside of the core hours may be required.
  + Comments – Due to the nature of the operation, this position will require occasional phone calls during off hours in order to keep production running or for the safety of the facility.

**Physical Requirements:**

Sitting, standing, some climbing stairs including catwalks, silos, ladders, etc. will be required along with stooping, bending and lifting. Sight and hearing is required to not only observe the process and personnel but also to effectively communicate with people and assist with problem solving. Must be able to move freely between facilities on the campus, as well as within each facility, in order to observe work processes and assist with problem solving and troubleshooting.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

There are no direct reports for this position but there are times when supervising maintenance or production operators will be required.

jobs.description:

**Job Code:** **46256**

**Job Location:** **Fort Wayne, IN**

**Job Schedule****: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris' Space and Mission Systems seeks an Electrical Engineer with subsystem leadership experience to join our growing team. The individual in this role will act as the primary electrical systems engineer responsible for a mission payload consisting of multiple circuit card designs to ensure seamless performance to requirements. They will have overall technical responsibility for the architecture and design of the electronic payload or payloads and serves as the primary electronic point of contact for external and internal segments, test, and operations. They will coordinate and/or perform test and analysis integration activities to ensure the system meets Customer and Mission requirements. They will coordinate all subsystem electrical efforts to generate contractually required system design documents and design review technical packages. They will technically lead and guide the detailed CCA designers and be the interface between the CCA designs and systems designs.

This position is located in Fort Wayne, IN: https://careers.l3harris.com/en/Fort-Wayne

**Essential Functions:**

* Manages and maintains the electrical integration of the electronic subsystems, mission payload and communications payload according to internal and external ICDs
* Generation and coordination of electrical design specifications and interface (internal and external) documents including requirements derivation, allocation, and flow up/down
* Derives and flows system-level electrical, interface, environmental, and applicable physical constraint requirements to subsystem, CCA, FPGA, software/firmware, and test-equipment implementation specifications
* Ensures electrical functional and physical allocations, changes and requirements compliance are being addressed throughout the subsystem design.
* Coordinates and/or completes electrical integration activities such as power, grounding schemes, and telemetry and command allocations
* Supports the AIT organization in planning the electrical integration testing of HW/SW from the CCA level to the subsystem level, including execution and troubleshooting issues
* Maintains cognizance and communicates changes of the SV subcontractor and in-house electrical design baselines, pinouts, and interfaces
* Works closely with Software, Mechanical, and Integration and Test to own and oversee subsystem integration across the full program lifecycle
* Represent subsystem electrical engineering during major system level design reviews such as SRR, SDR, PDR and CDR and milestone reviews such as MRR, TRR, PSF, LRR and MDR
* Leads or participates in failure review boards, engineering review boards, change control boards to ensure electrical impacts are coordinated
* Creating and/or supporting delivery of Customer CDRLs

* Ability to lead diverse technical teams across internal and subcontractor efforts
* Ability to obtain a Secret US security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience with electrical integration of electronics to meet mission performance
* Experience with leading electrical engineering teams
* Demonstrated experience leading electrical engineering teams through all phases of a space program; pursuits and proposal, design and development, integration and test, and operations
* Ability to make risk-based decisions balancing technical, cost and schedule
* Ability to lead, review, and coordinate electrical analyses and trades including power budgets, fault/failure analysis, EMI/EMC, grounding, signal/interface compatibility, and worst-case analysis
* Experience with electrical integration, testing, and troubleshooting of complex systems
* Well versed in developing or coordinating physical and functional electrical interface details such as first order circuit compatibility, voltage levels, current ratings, connector types, pin configurations, grounding requirements, signal protocols, data rates, communications interfaces and EMI/EMC/ESD considerations
* Experienced with electrical requirements validation, interface definition and closure, interconnect diagram development and ownership, sell-off, milestone entry/exit criteria
* Familiarity with electrical engineering processes and/or subsystems, such as power, command and data handling (C&DH), telemetry, tracking, and command (TT&C),
* Experience performing Worst Case analysis for power, analog, digital, and EMI across environmental requirements and derating
* Familiarity with tools such as DOORs, PSPICE, MathCAD, Matlab, Simulink, Allegro and MentorGraphics
* Ability to travel as required

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Embedded Systems / Flight Control Hardware
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**What You'll Get to Do**

Peraton Labs is searching for an Electrical Engineer to design and develop embedded electronic systems supporting unmanned, autonomous, and other advanced platforms for critical national security missions. You'll work across circuit design, embedded computing, flight control hardware, sensors, and imaging systems to rapidly prototype and mature integrated hardware capabilities.

  

**More About the Role**

As an Electrical Engineer, you'll provide hands-on engineering support from system architecture and component selection through schematic design, PCB development, firmware integration, board bring-up, and system testing. You'll work closely with software, mechanical, autonomy, and systems engineers to integrate flight controllers, processors, sensors, cameras, communications hardware, and other embedded components into complete platforms. This position requires 5 days a week on site at our Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland location.

  

#plabs26

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 2 years of experience; 0 years with a Master's degree.
* Experience designing and developing **embedded electronic systems**, including schematic design, component selection, PCB development, and hardware bring-up.
* Experience with **microcontrollers, embedded processors, or SoCs** and associated peripheral circuitry.
* Experience developing or integrating **flight control hardware, avionics, robotics, or other real-time embedded systems**.
* Working knowledge of embedded interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet, or similar.
* Experience developing, modifying, or debugging **embedded firmware** in C/C++ or similar languages.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting hardware and firmware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and other laboratory equipment.
* Ability to integrate sensors, communications devices, and other peripherals into embedded platforms.
* US Citizenship

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience developing hardware for **UAS, robotics, autonomous systems, or aerospace platforms**.
* Experience with flight controllers, IMUs, GNSS receivers, ESCs, servos, motor control, or related avionics.
* Experience integrating **cameras, image sensors, video processing hardware, or electro-optical systems**.
* Familiarity with camera interfaces such as MIPI CSI, USB, Ethernet, or similar high-speed interfaces.
* Experience with embedded Linux, RTOS environments, or bare-metal firmware development.
* Familiarity with STM32, NXP, TI, Microchip, NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi Compute Module, or similar embedded platforms.
* Experience with power distribution, battery-powered systems, DC/DC conversion, and power integrity.
* Experience with PCB layout considerations for mixed-signal, high-speed digital, or compact embedded systems.
* Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, ROS/ROS 2, or similar flight control and robotics ecosystems.
* Experience rapidly prototyping and integrating custom embedded hardware into operational or test platforms.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a IoT / Edge Software Engineer to join our team in Bethesda (REMOTE), Maryland (US-MD), United States (US).
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
The IoT Edge Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of edge software components that enable secure, reliable, and scalable integration between field-deployed dosimeter devices, gateways, and cloud environment. This role is central to the modernization of client's radiation exposure management, focusing on the implementation and optimization of AWS Greengrass-based IoT gateway solutions, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) device communication, and secure data transmission protocols. The engineer works closely with system architects, backend/API engineers, and operational stakeholders to ensure that edge software components support real-time dosimeter data ingestion, device management, firmware updates, and operational status monitoring in compliance with cybersecurity and privacy requirements. The IoT Edge Software Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining software modules that run on Linux-based gateway hardware, supporting features such as device authentication, data encryption, remote updates, and automated diagnostics. The position requires hands-on experience with embedded Linux, MQTT messaging, and integration with AWS IoT Core, as well as the ability to troubleshoot and optimize edge-to-cloud workflows for performance, reliability, and security. The engineer ensures that all edge software is auditable, maintainable, and aligned with the mission-critical needs of operational communities, supporting both connected and disconnected operational scenarios. This role is essential for delivering a robust, secure, and resilient edge computing infrastructure that enables client to provide accurate, timely, and actionable radiation exposure data across enterprise.
  
  
**Job Duties:**  

* Design, develop, and maintain edge software modules for IoT gateways, supporting BLE dosimeter communication, device management, and secure data transmission
* Implement and optimize AWS Greengrass components for deployment on Linux-based gateway hardware
* Develop and maintain secure device authentication, data encryption, and remote firmware update capabilities
* Integrate edge software with AWS IoT Core, MQTT messaging, and cloud services
* Support real-time and batch data ingestion workflows, including handling of disconnected operations and automated re-synchronization
* Collaborate with backend, security, and DevSecOps teams to ensure compliance with DoD IL4, FedRAMP, and RMF requirements
* Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance edge software performance, reliability, and security
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for edge software components, deployment procedures, and operational workflows
* Participate in code reviews, security assessments, and compliance audits as required by contract and SOW
* Provide technical support for field deployment, user acceptance testing, and ongoing operations of edge solutions

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as engineering or mathematics (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Information Systems)
* Minimum 6 years of experience with software engineering
* Minimum 1 year of experience developing backend services and APIs for cloud-based, IoT-enabled, or regulated federal systems
* Minimum 1 year of experience with applying modern software development methodologies (e.g., agile, DEVOPS/DEVSECOPS) in a professional or academic setting
* US citizenship

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience with applying programming concepts in a professional or academic setting
* Experience developing backend services and APIs for cloud-based, IoT-enabled, or regulated federal systems
* Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar languages used for backend and API development
* Familiarity with AWS GovCloud, Greengrass, and secure data integration in DoD environments
* Experience implementing RBAC, organizational hierarchy, and secure authentication/authorization mechanisms
* Knowledge of DoD cybersecurity, privacy, and RMF requirements for IL4/IL5 systems
* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices
* Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to produce technical specifications and API documentation
* Experience supporting data migration, legacy system integration, and operational troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. **Job Summary:**

The Junior IT Systems Engineer (Athena Support) will provide technical support and routine systems administration within a HIPAA-compliant healthcare environment, with a particular emphasis on supporting the athenaOne electronic health record (EHR) platform. Responsibilities include troubleshooting IT systems, supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, and network infrastructure, and assisting with athenaOne user administration, configurations, and clinical workflows. The ideal candidate will have hands-on athenaOne experience, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to support both technical and clinical staff. Complex EHR configurations and clinical workflow changes will be escalated to the designated EHR administrator.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**IT Support and Troubleshooting:**

* Provide first- and second-level support for hardware and software issues, including those related to Windows, macOS, and Microsoft Office, utilizing the Zendesk ticketing system.
* Assist in the management and troubleshooting of network devices such as laptops, desktops, and printers, as well as supporting systems like Active Directory, Azure, and Intune.

**Systems Administration:**

* Support the administration and maintenance of Active Directory, Azure services, and device management through Intune.
* Assist in the configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of network hardware and software, specifically Meraki solutions.

* Troubleshoot common athenaOne issues, including patient searches, navigation, and application functionality, using O-Help, Success Community, and athenahealth support cases.
* Document and track athenaOne support requests in Zendesk, maintain procedures, protect PHI, and escalate complex or patient-care-impacting issues to the EHR administrator.

* Maintain accurate IT and athenaOne support documentation, system configurations, and procedures in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.

All badges require successful completion of the associated learning journeys and exams.

**Summary:**

  
  

The R&D Electrical Engineer supports the electrical and electronic hardware development activities of instrumented, automated diagnostic systems. A member of a project team, they work closely with other development engineering functions, software, mechanical, and systems. This role interfaces with manufacturing, regulatory, and quality teams to ensure product reliability, quality, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

  
  

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented Electrical Engineer with experience developing electrical and electronic hardware for complex, instrumented systems. They are a strong communicator and collaborator who works effectively across software, mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams.

  
  

They possess excellent technical writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including experience with root-cause investigation and failure analysis. Most importantly, they demonstrate a strong commitment to quality, reliability, and regulatory compliance, helping deliver high-performing diagnostic products that meet rigorous medical device standards.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Support the design and development of electrical, electronic and electro-optic components and systems for automated diagnostic instruments.
* Participate and hold design reviews for modules and subsystems.
* Design and develop microcontroller-based modules.
* Assess the ability of proposed designs to meet specified requirements including manufacturability and serviceability.
* Learn and practice the Global Product Development System phase and gate design process. Conduct project work in compliance with internal procedures and processes, ISO 9001, and FDA cGMP standards for the design of Medical Devices.
* Learn and practice design for compliance to IVD and medical standards for safety, EMC, and security.
* Interact closely with software, systems, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering functions to develop comprehensive solutions to design problems.
* Develop and execute functional tests for modules and systems.
* Conduct failure investigations and root cause analyses documenting the results.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  
  

* BS in Electrical or Computer Engineering.
* Hands-on experience building and testing breadboards and prototypes.
* Experience working with microcontrollers.
* Experience using schematic capture and PCB layout tools.
* Familiarity working with standard lab equipment, oscilloscope, logic analyzer, MCU debug probes.
* Solid understanding of basic electronic circuits and components, LEDs, photodetectors, sensors, amplifiers, voltage regulators, logic, ADC, DAC, memory.
* Good understanding of electro-mechanical components, motors, blowers, heaters, TEC, solenoids, relays.
  

  

**Preferred Experience:**

  

* Experience with Altium
* Experience with embedded programming experience in Assembler, C or HDL languages.
* Experience in BOM management and PCBA ordering
* Experience with motion control.
* Experience in the design of analog and mixed signal circuits, sensor to ADC to MCU.

**Why Join Us?**
================

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

Join us as a Software Engineer 2 in Hopkinton, Massachusetts and Round Rock, Texas to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.

**What you’ll achieve**
-----------------------

Design, develop, and integrate embedded firmware for enterprise server system management subsystems, delivering scalable, high-performance, and secure solutions

**You will:**

* Embed security across the firmware lifecycle by translating security, risk, and compliance requirements into architecture, designs, implementation plans, and validation strategies
* Lead firmware integration across multiple hardware generations while driving Agile execution through sprint planning, backlog management, estimation, and delivery
* Perform advanced system-level debugging and root cause analysis to resolve customer, manufacturing, and pre-production issues, improving firmware quality, security, and resilience
* Establish and promote best practices in secure firmware development, automated validation, and continuous process improvement to enhance code quality, developer productivity, system reliability, and infrastructure security

**Take the first step towards your dream career**
-------------------------------------------------

**Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Essential Requirements:**
---------------------------

* Firmware and embedded systems development with strong proficiency in C/C++ programming
* Experience developing and supporting Linux-based platforms and embedded environments
* Deep understanding of hardware/software architecture, system interactions, and platform management technologies (OpenBMC, IPMI, Redfish, I2C)
* Expertise in software engineering best practices, testing, validation, Agile development, and tools such as Yocto, BitBake, JIRA, and AI-assisted development platforms (Claude/Devin)
* Strong system-level debugging, troubleshooting, and security-focused development experience

**Compensation**

Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $122k - $158k.

**Benefits and Perks of working at Dell Technologies**

Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member — right now at MyWellatDell.com

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test, Embedded Firmware
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test with an interest in embedded firmware to join our IoT (Internet of Things) group. The group develops software for the microcontroller-based sensor hardware designed and manufactured in-house. Our products offer an interesting engineering challenge: microcontrollers with just a few hundred kilobytes of RAM and code space must collect data from sensors such as accelerometers and GPS, communicate with back-end systems over the Internet and nearby devices with Bluetooth, perform over-the-air upgrades with new firmware, and manage cryptographically-secured storage — all while using so little power that they can run for years on a battery.

CMT is looking for a **Software Engineer in Test II, Embedded Firmware** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

**Responsibilities:**

* Use independent judgment and responsibility to contribute to the development and maintenance of test infrastructure for firmware validation under the guidance of senior engineers
* Execute and monitor firmware test runs across simulated firmware on Linux servers and real firmware on device
* Write and maintain automated tests to improve coverage and enhance failure visibility
* Use Python for test harnesses and scripting, with exposure to C for understanding firmware under test
* Use Linux for development and git for source code management
* Learn and apply knowledge of embedded microcontroller systems as it relates to firmware testing
* Assist with test systems attached to equipment capable of measuring parameters like power usage • Gain familiarity with microcontroller circuit boards (e.g., Arduino-like devices), multimeters, benchtop power supplies, and electronic schematics
* Support web services for test coordination and result display, leveraging knowledge of REST APIs and web application development
* Triage and investigate test failures, distinguishing between firmware regressions and infrastructure issues
* Complete any additional tasks as they arise

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* 2+ years of relevant working experience
* Proficiency in Python programming; willingness to read and understand C
* Comfortable working on the Linux command-line and performing basic system administration tasks
* Experience writing and running automated tests, ideally in a CI environment
* Familiarity with git and standard development workflows
* Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) is a plus
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
* Collaborative with the ability to work with diverse teams across the globe
* Eager to learn and grow — a "leave things better than you found them" mindset
* Ability to balance speed and quality and ask for help when needed

**Nice to Haves:**

* Exposure to embedded systems, microcontrollers, or low-level programming
* Experience with hardware test setups — oscilloscopes, multimeters, or reading basic schematics
* Experience with SQL
* Interest in performance measurement and instrumentation
* Knowledge of QA engineering practices such as test planning, defect lifecycle management, and requirements traceability
* Experience with build systems or release processes

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience, and annual performance bonus
* Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance, matching 401k, short-term & long-term disability and parental leave
* Unlimited Paid Time Off including vacation, sick days & public holidays
* Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities

**Base Salary Range**

* The base salary range for this position is: $85,700 to $107,100. This range is specifically for Cambridge, MA

**A****dditional Perks:**

* Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world
* Join an industry leader — 65 million drivers protected, powering 140+ programs across 25 countries
* Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified
* Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety
* Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters
* High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact
* Unlimited PTO, flexible scheduling, competitive salary, annual performance bonus, RSUs, and full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401k match
* Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge
* Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA+, Women, Book Club, and Health & Wellness
* Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:**

At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cm
