jobs.title: Senior Staff/Principal Software Engineer - GPU System Software, Onboard Execution
jobs.description:
Zoox is building a purpose-built robotaxi from the ground up and running it on public roads today, with riders. Every perception, prediction, and planning decision runs on an onboard compute: a fixed-power, fixed-thermal, safety-critical, real-time system.

That makes GPU execution one of the most consequential engineering problems in the company. Each new model generation wants more compute. Each new vehicle generation needs to cost less, use less power, and stay safe. Closing that gap is not a kernel-tuning exercise. It takes an end-to-end technical vision for how the whole onboard AI workload is scheduled, shared, isolated, and sized across GPUs, and the authority to drive that vision across ML, autonomy, middleware, and hardware organizations.

You will join Zoox's Software Performance organization, which owns end-to-end performance of the onboard software stack: profiling and observability, GPU compute, and compute platform. You will work closely with Perception, Prediction, Planning, ML Infrastructure, and Hardware teams, and you will be a senior technical voice for onboard compute across the company.

We are looking for the technical leader who sets that vision. You will define how Zoox runs AI on the vehicle, and you will own the strategy for doing more with less compute on every vehicle we build next.

### **In this role, you will:**

* **Architect onboard GPU execution.** Define how perception, prediction, and planning workloads share onboard GPUs, including scheduling, multi-tenancy, isolation, and deterministic latency under contention.
* **Drive compute reduction.** Own the multi-year roadmap to cut onboard compute per vehicle by setting latency and utilization budgets and landing the biggest levers across models, runtimes, middleware, and hardware in real releases.
* **Shape hardware and platform direction.** Guide next-generation compute decisions (GPU and SoC selection, topology, memory budgets) with workload models and performance projections that justify them, then lead performance bring-up of each new platform.
* **Lead inference performance at scale.** Set direction for the inference stack (TensorRT, CUDA, custom kernels, quantization) and partner with ML teams so models are designed for the hardware they ship on.
* **Provide technical leadership.** Lead and mentor senior engineers, align directors and VPs through design docs, and make the hard calls when performance, safety, and schedule conflict.

### **Qualifications**

* BS in computer science, computer engineering, or related field and 10+ years in systems or performance engineering, including leading GPU or accelerator architecture across teams, or building and leading a performance engineering team.
* Deep CUDA platform (programming model, runtime, and driver) and NVIDIA GPU microarchitecture expertise (Ampere through Blackwell, Orin, Thor).
* Proven record setting technical direction and delivering large, measurable end-to-end gains in latency, utilization, or cost.
* Working knowledge of ML inference optimization (TensorRT, XLA, Triton, quantization, fusion) and expert C++ on Linux.
* Ability to align ML, systems, hardware, and leadership on a shared technical plan.

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Real-time or embedded GPU experience: autonomy, robotics, AR/VR, games, or HPC.  
  Production GPU multi-tenancy (MPS, MIG, priority streams).  
  New GPU architecture or platform bring-up, benchmarking methodology, or workload modeling and projections.

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

**Accommodations**

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Controls and Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Mueller Coatings | East Bridgewater, MA**

Mueller Coatings is seeking a hands-on **Controls & Automation Engineer** to improve manufacturing performance through reliable controls, practical automation, and effective problem-solving.

In this role, you will design, program, troubleshoot, and improve systems supporting vacuum metalizing, spray coating, and related manufacturing operations. You will work closely with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, and Quality to reduce downtime, improve process consistency, and bring automation projects from concept to production.

Our values—**Excellence, Dependability, Teamwork, and Innovation**—guide how we work, solve problems, and support one another.

What You’ll Do

**Develop and improve control systems**

* Design, program, troubleshoot, and maintain PLCs, HMIs, sensors, motor controls, variable frequency drives, and industrial control networks.
* Develop equipment sequences, operator interfaces, alarms, and diagnostics that simplify operation and troubleshooting.
* Integrate controls for vacuum systems, coating equipment, ovens, conveyors, pumps, and material handling equipment.
* Upgrade aging control systems and maintain accurate electrical schematics, program backups, and revision records.

**Bring practical automation to the manufacturing floor**

* Identify opportunities to automate part handling, loading and unloading, coating application, inspection, and packaging.
* Develop automation concepts, project requirements, cost estimates, and expected operating benefits.
* Program and support FANUC and other robotic systems, and integrate robots, cobots, machine vision, and automated fixtures.
* Develop solutions that accommodate different part geometries, production volumes, and changeover requirements.
* Reduce manual handling, cycle time, process variation, and scrap.

**Solve problems and strengthen equipment reliability**

* Diagnose electrical, controls, and automation issues affecting production.
* Partner with Maintenance to identify root causes and implement lasting corrective actions.
* Improve equipment diagnostics and support preventive maintenance practices.
* Train operators and maintenance technicians on controls, proper operation, and fault recovery.
* Provide hands-on support during installations, startup, and production interruptions.

**Support quality, safety, and project execution**

* Develop controls that maintain repeatable temperature, timing, pressure, vacuum, and coating application parameters.
* Implement recipe management, process monitoring, data collection, and traceability where needed.
* Work with Quality and Process Engineering to verify that changes meet approved process specifications.
* Manage assigned projects through installation, commissioning, acceptance testing, and production handoff.
* Coordinate with equipment builders, integrators, contractors, and suppliers.
* Partner with EHS and Maintenance on machine guarding, interlocks, and safety controls, and follow established change control, lockout/tagout, and electrical safety procedures.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field; equivalent technical education and relevant experience will be considered.
* At least three years of hands-on experience in industrial controls, automation, or manufacturing equipment engineering.
* Demonstrated experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs and HMIs.
* Working knowledge of industrial electrical systems, instrumentation, sensors, motor controls, and control panel components.
* Ability to read, interpret, and update electrical schematics.
* Experience troubleshooting equipment that combines electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, and process systems.
* Strong problem-solving, project organization, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with operators, technicians, engineers, and outside suppliers.
* Ability to work independently and have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with other team members and facility leadership.

**Preferred experience includes:**

* Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation and AutomationDirect control platforms.
* FANUC robotics, cobots, machine vision, or motion control.
* Vacuum equipment, automated coating systems, spray equipment, cure ovens, or conveyors.
* Manufacturing data collection, equipment monitoring, or MES integration.
* Manufacturing environments with varied products and frequent changeovers.
* Machine safety systems and applicable industrial electrical standards.
* Evaluating automation investments through labor savings, capacity improvements, quality gains, and payback.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means fewer recurring equipment failures, reduced controls-related downtime, improved throughput and process repeatability, and automation projects that achieve documented benefits. It also means completing projects within approved schedules and budgets and leaving employees with the documentation, training, and tools needed to support the equipment.

**Work Environment**

This position combines engineering work with regular hands-on activity on the manufacturing floor. Work may involve coating materials, operating machinery, elevated temperatures, and industrial noise. Required personal protective equipment and established safety procedures must be followed. Occasional support outside normal operating hours may be needed for installations, planned shutdowns, or urgent equipment issues.

**Interested in turning ideas into reliable manufacturing solutions? Apply with your resume and share your experience with industrial controls, robotics, and automation.**

We are a world-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50+ locations world-wide. Much of our work contributes to innovative research in the fields of sensor science, signal processing, data fusion, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and augmented reality (AR).

QinetiQ US’s dedicated experts in defense, aerospace, security, and related fields all work together to explore new ways of protecting the American Warfighter, Security Forces, and Allies. Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. Partnering with our customers, we help save lives; reduce risks to society; and maintain the global infrastructure on which we all depend.

**Why Join QinetiQ US?**

If you have the courage to take on a wide variety of complex challenges, then you will experience a unique working environment where innovative teams blend different perspectives, disciplines, and technologies to discover new ways of solving complex problems. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. QinetiQ US will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Your work will span from multi-megawatt military vehicle electrification, compact underwater propulsion units for AUVs, unmanned ground robots, and the modernization of onboard power electronics and actuator systems for the Navy’s newest submarine designs, bringing proven technology into the next generation of undersea platforms.

QinetiQ’s Advanced Robotics and Mission Solutions (AR&MS) group draws on decades of experience developing and delivering leading-edge, mission-ready systems. From frontline unmanned ground robots to ship and submarine systems on which missions depend, our teams are driven by mission-led innovation and a commitment to overcoming the threats of tomorrow.

* Work within a multidisciplinary teams of mechanical, electrical, software, and controls engineers to design and support complex systems
* Work with the team to oversee the entire component life-cycle from proposal, concept design, prototype build, and production implementation.
* Design and develop new and novel features for existing products
* Troubleshoot and root cause challenging component and systems problems
* Spearhead the electrical design and testing to MIL-Spec

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or equivalent discipline with 5+ years of related experience
* Hands-on experience building and testing systems
* Familiarity with MIL-Specs and MIL-PRFs related to electrical engineering
* Ability to see programs through from proposal to production
* Experience interfacing and collaborating with customers
* Prior mentorship roles especially within an engineering setting
* Experience with CAD/Analysis programs
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance if required

The salary range for this role is $94,100.00 - $130,000 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure, Google Cloud Networking
jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in C++, C, or Python.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* 3 years of experience developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networking, or experience with compute technologies or hardware architecture.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------

**About the Team**  
Compute & Connectivity Hardware (CCH) is part of GM’s Software & Services organization and owns the hardware foundation for GM’s software-defined vehicles. The team develops and integrates the compute, connectivity, networking, and electronic platforms that support vehicle intelligence, infotainment, ADAS, mechatronic controls, connected services, and over-the-air experiences.

CCH work spans architecture, requirements, hardware design, embedded systems, cybersecurity, functional safety, integration, validation, launch, and field performance. Our engineers collaborate across software, systems, controls, vehicle engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing to solve complex technical problems and deliver reliable, production-ready hardware across GM’s vehicle portfolio.

General Motors is at the forefront of the transformation of automotive with the electrification of our portfolio and the development of leading-edge central compute and autonomous capabilities. Our Central Compute Hardware (CCH) Mechanical Design team is a dynamic, innovative group focused on developing enclosures, mechanical assemblies, and test solutions for next-generation electronics used across future ICE and EV vehicles manufactured by GM.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Hardware Engineer, Compute Validation
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

### **About the Team**

Compute & Connectivity Hardware (CCH) is part of GM’s Vehicle Software & Electronics Engineering (VSEE) organization within Software & Services Engineering. The team develops the physical hardware foundation for GM’s software-defined vehicles, including compute, connectivity, networking, displays, and other electronic platforms that enable in-vehicle software, infotainment, ADAS, vehicle controls, and connected experiences.

  

CCH’s work spans architecture, requirements, hardware and electronics design, embedded hardware, systems integration, validation, launch, and in-market performance. Our engineers collaborate across software, systems, controls, cybersecurity, functional safety, vehicle engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing to develop reliable, production-ready hardware for GM’s vehicle portfolio.

  

**The Role**

At General Motors, we're redefining the vehicle through centralized computing, advanced electrical architectures, and software-defined capabilities. Our Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform powers next-generation features including automated driving, connected services, and immersive digital experiences. At the center of this transformation is GM's in-house designed Central Compute Unit (CCU), a high-performance, liquid-cooled computing platform that serves as the foundation for future vehicle intelligence.

  

As a Senior Hardware Validation Engineer - Compute Validation, you will be responsible for validating and releasing next-generation compute hardware that powers GM's software-defined vehicles. You will lead validation activities for complex ECU platforms, owning test strategy, execution, issue resolution, and release readiness across environmental, EMC, and functional validation domains. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on debugging expertise, and close collaboration with hardware, software, systems, manufacturing, and vehicle integration teams.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

Compute Hardware Validation

* Lead validation planning and execution for central compute platforms throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Develop validation strategies, test plans, and coverage aligned with product requirements, technical risks, and program milestones.
* Define interface validation requirements, test methods, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive issue identification, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and closure of hardware validation concerns.
* Partner with design engineers to incorporate validation learnings into product improvements and future designs.

Environmental & EMC Validation

* Own environmental validation activities including thermal, vibration, mechanical shock, humidity, and reliability testing.
* Lead EMC/EMI validation readiness, execution, issue triage, and corrective action tracking.
* Collaborate with internal and external laboratories to develop test setups, review results, and drive resolution of validation failures.
* Improve hardware robustness and compliance performance through data-driven validation insights.

Hardware Bring-Up & Debug

* Lead board bring-up and validation of prototype and production-intent hardware.
* Perform hands-on lab testing including power measurements, signal integrity assessments, thermal characterization, and stress testing.
* Investigate and resolve issues involving power delivery, high-speed interfaces, environmental performance, and EMC behavior.
* Assess validation results and provide clear recommendations regarding product readiness and technical risk.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Collaborate with silicon vendors and cross-functional teams including hardware, software, systems, safety, manufacturing, and vehicle integration.
* Support technical reviews, validation reviews, and program milestone assessments.
* Provide technical leadership within validation workstreams and help drive alignment across engineering teams and external partners.

Quality & Compliance

* Ensure validation activities support automotive reliability, EMC, manufacturability, and quality requirements.
* Support DVP&R, DFMEA, requirements traceability, and coverage analysis.
* Communicate validation results, risks, and recommendations to engineering and program leadership.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in hardware validation, embedded electronics, ECU development, or compute platform engineering.
* Strong experience validating complex automotive electronic modules or compute systems.
* Experience leading environmental and/or EMC validation activities for automotive hardware.
* Knowledge of automotive hardware development processes, reliability engineering, and product release methodologies.
* Strong understanding of: Digital electronics and embedded hardware fundamentals Power distribution and system architecture High-speed interfaces including PCIe, Ethernet, USB, and DDR Hardware bring-up, debugging, and failure analysis Automotive environmental and EMC validation processes
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, multimeters, and debug tools.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to independently drive technical issues to resolution across cross-functional teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Central Compute, ADAS, Autonomous Driving, Infotainment, or other high-performance embedded computing platforms.
* Familiarity with DVP&R, DFMEA, requirements management, and traceability processes.
* Experience validating hardware utilizing high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, USB, and SerDes technologies.

jobs.description:
### **Description**

We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area.  
  
More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation!  
  
**About The Team**  
The Hub Applications team builds core functionality of the software that runs on SmartThings hubs and keeps them connected to the cloud. Written primarily in Rust, our software is responsible for letting millions of connected homes reliably control their devices, stay in sync, and receive improvements over time. Some of our core responsibilities are:

* **Local device execution:** Building and maintaining the runtime that lets hubs run device integrations directly on the hub.
* **Hub and cloud data flow:** Ensuring device state, events, and commands move reliably between hubs and the cloud, that cloud and hub data records stay synchronized, and that hubs recover gracefully after losing connectivity.
* **Core hub software architecture:** Reshaping the hub’s core services so they’re easier to maintain, faster, and ready for new hardware..
* **Configuration and system management:** Designing how hubs receive, validate, and safely roll back configuration, and keeping core system behavior such as timekeeping consistent and resilient.
* **Release quality and observability:** Monitoring software releases across the hub population and building the metrics and tooling that surface problems early.

**About The Role**

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Applications team. This is a deeply hands-on role for someone with expert-level Rust skills. You’ll write, review, and set the standard for the Rust code that runs on millions of SmartThings hubs, where performance, memory use, and reliability on resource-constrained devices matter. Comfort with Rust’s ownership model, concurrency, and error handling is essential, as is experience working across the boundary between Rust and existing C code.

You’ll help drive long-term technical strategy for our core areas, including evolving the hub’s foundational software toward a more modular, maintainable design. Operating with autonomy, you’ll bring clarity to complex, cross-functional challenges and act as a go-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives. Close partnership with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams will shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. Mentoring engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and guiding how the team adopts AI-assisted development and operational practices are also part of the role.

This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown, with paid attached parking!).

The pay range for this role is $139,000 to $198,000, with an annual bonus target of 20%.

### **Key Responsibilities**

In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:

* **Technical Strategy Ownership:** Own the long-term technical direction for one or more Hub Applications domains.
* **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Lead large, cross-team projects as the technical owner, from design through rollout.
* **Architect for Reliability & Scale:** Guide architecture and design decisions for systems such as local device execution, hub-to-cloud data synchronization, and hub configuration and software asset management, with stability, resilience to unreliable connectivity, and operational excellence as first-class concerns.
* **Rust Technical Leadership:** Serve as a deep Rust expert for the team. Set the standard for how we write, review, and test Rust that runs on resource-constrained devices, with performance, memory efficiency, and safe concurrency as everyday concerns. Guide the evolution of existing code, including where Rust meets legacy C.
* **AI Practices & Vision Collaboration:** Help define how the team uses AI-assisted development and operational tooling, evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve velocity and quality, and set a forward-looking vision for responsible AI adoption in the organization.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs.
* **Mentor & Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, including senior engineers, and help build engineering practices that raise the bar across the org.
* **Operational Excellence & On-Call:** Participate in observability, incident response, and on-call rotations supporting the production firmware delivery and hub connectivity.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

**What You Bring On Day One (Required Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
* 8+ years of production software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record operating at a Staff-level technical leadership capacity
* Expert-level proficiency in Rust, with deep knowledge of ownership and lifetimes, async and multithreaded concurrency, error handling, and writing performant, memory-efficient code for resource-constrained devices
* Strong systems programming experience on embedded Linux or similar constrained environments, including debugging crashes, memory issues, and performance problems in product

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Redwood Materials**

**Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.**

**Controls Engineer**

We are seeking an experienced Controls Engineer who is passionate about pushing beyond the cutting edge of the industry to design, build, and debug best-in-class controls systems for Redwood's battery recycling operations. This engineer will play a critical role in designing, commissioning, scaling, and supporting all of Redwood's recycling facilities working at the intersection of chemical process engineering, industrial automation, and software development.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Designing and implementing real‑time control software in C++ for embedded and industrial systems
* Developing automation tools, diagnostics, and orchestration scripts in Python
* Writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting Structured Text (IEC 61131‑3) for PLCs and industrial controllers
* Building deterministic control loops, state machines, and safety‑critical routines
* Integrating software with sensors, actuators, drives, and industrial communication networks
* Debugging complex issues involving timing, concurrency, hardware interfaces, and industrial protocols
* Leading system architecture decisions for control platforms and distributed automation systems
* Conducting root‑cause analysis for field issues and implementing long‑term fixes
* Collaborating with controls, electrical, and product teams to translate requirements into robust software designs
* Mentoring engineers in real‑time programming, PLC development, and industrial best practices

**Qualifications:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in controls engineering, industrial automation, or system integration within a high-volume manufacturing environment
* Proficiency in modern C++ for real‑time or embedded systems
* Solid experience with Python for automation, tooling, or data processing
* Hands‑on experience writing Structured Text for PLCs or industrial controllers
* Deep understanding of deterministic execution, concurrency, and hardware‑software interaction
* Experience with industrial protocols such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, OPC UA, or PROFINET
* Proven ability to lead complex engineering efforts while contributing significant hands‑on code
* Strong debugging skills across software, hardware, and network layers
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with motion control, robotics, or process automation
* Familiarity with embedded Linux, RTOS environments, or microcontroller development
* Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity standards or best practices
* Experience with simulation tools, digital twins, or hardware‑in‑the‑loop testing
* Background integrating C++ runtimes with PLC or SCADA systems

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

  

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: Principal Hardware Engineer - Hardware Development Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

BAE Systems is seeking a Hardware Development Lead for development programs within our Electronic Combat Solutions (ECS) business.

**The Mission: Protecting Those Who Protect Us**

At BAE Systems, we don't just build electronics; we create the decisive edge. Our Electronic Combat Solutions (ECS) team is developing the next generation of disruptive technologies that safeguard warfighters across land, sea, and air. We are looking for a Hardware Development Lead who is as passionate about technical excellence as they are about leading people.

**The Challenge**
  
You will lead a multi-disciplinary team of 5-10+ engineers (Electrical, Mechanical, and Design Drafting) to push the boundaries of what is possible in rugged custom electronics. This isn't just about managing a schedule—it’s about solving the complex engineering hurdles associated with high-speed digital/mixed-signal circuit cards in the most demanding environments on earth.

**Your Impact as a Technical Leader**

* **Drive Technical Excellence**: Lead critical design reviews and architect hardware strategies that ensure program success and system reliability.

* **Mentor and Scale**: Grow the technical maturity of your team by providing guidance, fostering innovation, and ensuring the "right person is in the right job."

* **Bridge the Gap**: Act as the primary technical conduit between engineering, procurement, operations, and program management to move a design from concept to deployment.

* **Shape the** **Futu****re**: Support program capture and proposal teams by defining hardware baselines and estimating the technical effort required for next-gen capabilities.

* **Own the Execution**: Balance the rigors of the Hardware Development Process with the agility needed to solve complex, real-world engineering problems on aggressive schedules.

**Why Join BAE Systems?**

We value the "deep work" required for engineering excellence. That’s why we offer a hybrid work format that balances collaborative, in-person lab work with remote focus time. We support your life outside of work with:

* **Every Other Friday Off** (9/80 schedule)
* **Flextime & Telecommuting**
* **A Culture of Recognition** for extraordinary technical contributions.

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* **Proven Technical Pedigree:** A BSEE, BSME, or related field and 6+ years of experience. You have a strong technical background related to complex digital/mixed-signal designs with embedded processors, FPGAs, and high-speed serial interfaces—from initial requirements through to successful verification.
* **Multidisciplinary Leadership:** Experience leading integrated teams of Electrical, Mechanical, and Drafting engineers.
* **Lifecycle Expertise:** Knowledge of the hardware product lifecycle, from concept, to schematic capture and PCB layout to environmental qualification.
* **Strategic Mindset:** An understanding for managing cost and schedule to ensure technical goals align with program constraints. Prior Earned Value Management (EVM) or Cost Account Management (CAM) experience is desirable.
* **Clearance:** Ability to obtain or maintain a DoD Security Clearance (Active Secret preferred)
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

jobs.title: Vision Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Crane Currency as a **Vision Engineer** in **Nashua, New Hampshire**, and take the lead in bringing advanced machine-vision and automated inspection technologies from concept to production.

**Who we are:**

Crane Currency is a premier industrial technology company and a pioneer in currency manufacturing and advanced micro-optics technology for securing physical products. Yes, chances are you have our product in your wallet right now! Our sophisticated equipment and software leverage proprietary core capabilities with detection and sensing technologies. Around the world, our customers trust us to anticipate their needs with innovative, reliable, and high-quality currency & authentication solutions and services—just as they have for generations. Learn more at www.cranecurrency.com

**How you will make an impact:**

As a Vision Engineer within Technology Transfer, you will lead the design, deployment, commissioning, validation, and stabilization of machine-vision and automated-inspection systems across manufacturing sites. You will translate product and process inspection requirements into reliable vision solutions that meet safety, quality, detection, throughput, and operational-readiness requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, site technical teams, suppliers, and integrators, you will resolve complex hardware, software, optics, lighting, calibration, and application challenges. You will also document system performance and build the receiving site’s capability to operate and support each solution following project completion.

* Own the vision-system workstream for assigned technology-transfer projects from requirements definition through stable production and formal site handoff.
* Partner with product, process, quality, and manufacturing stakeholders to define inspection objectives, defect criteria, measurement needs, cycle-time requirements, and acceptance standards.
* Design or specify machine-vision solutions using appropriate cameras, lenses, lighting, sensors, electronics, computing hardware, communications, and image-processing methods.
* Configure and integrate vision-system hardware and software with production equipment, controls, data systems, and operator interfaces.
* Develop or modify vision applications, recipes, inspection logic, image-processing algorithms, and supporting software; VB.NET or C# experience is beneficial.
* Plan and execute installation, startup, calibration, FAT, SAT, qualification, and performance-verification activities.
* Conduct technical risk assessments to identify failure modes, detection gaps, false accepts, false rejects, and design limitations; define mitigations and test strategies.
* Troubleshoot image quality, lighting, optics, triggering, communications, software, algorithms, calibration, and equipment-integration issues using structured root-cause analysis.

**Knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Optical Engineering or commensurate experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, integrating, programming, or supporting machine-vision systems.
* Applied knowledge of lighting, optics, cameras, electronics, image formation, and imaging algorithms.
* Experience defining inspection requirements, selecting components, and evaluating vision-system performance in manufacturing applications.
* Experience installing, commissioning, testing, validating, troubleshooting, and supporting machine-vision or automated-inspection systems in production.
* Ability to assess technical risk, identify potential failure modes or design shortcomings, define mitigations, and establish test strategies.

Preferred:

* Master’s degree in a related discipline with relevant applied experience.
* Experience with FAT, SAT, qualification, calibration, and objective performance verification.
* Programming experience with VB.NET, C#, or comparable languages used for vision applications.
* Strong project-management, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**How we will care for you:**

We offer top-notch benefits, including medical, dental, vision, company bonus plan, 401(K) match and more. Discover more about our benefits here: https://www.cranecurrency.com/careers/benefits/

**What drives our team:**

We are a passionate team of 1,300 creators and problem solvers, united by our purpose, we give people confidence every day in moments that matter. This comes to life through our Shared Values:

* People Matter
* Do the Right Thing
* Trusted Partner
* Innovate for Growth
* Always Improving

Learn more about our values and culture: Life at Crane Currency

You can also check us out at: Crane Currency on Glassdoor

**Where we are:**

Your role is in Nashua, New Hampshire, a 40-mile drive from the vibrant heart of Boston. Check out what makes Nashua a great place to live and work here: Nashua Site Location Packet

Crane Currency is a drug free workplace.

SUITABILITY AND BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION REQUIREMENTS: The final offer of employment will be subject to the applicant's successful completion of a background investigation and favorable adjudication. Failure to successfully meet these requirements will be grounds for disqualification in the hiring process. The background investigation process conducted by Crane and our U.S. Government Agency customers is very thorough. Therefore, it is imperative that applicants exercise candor and honesty when answering background questionnaires, especially as it relates to arrest, employment, education, finances, illegal drug use, and/or other criminal history. Falsification discovered in security documents or during the background investigation process may result in an immediate negative suitability determination.

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Systems Engineer

Virgin Galactic is hiring a Sr. Mechanical Systems Engineer with a background in hardware integration for Aerospace and/or Space applications, including new development as well as in-service programs. Guided by our values, “Safety Above All”, we proactively manage the risks inherent in human spaceflight through our daily actions. You will be creating innovative designs and problem resolutions that meet our demanding requirements through prototyping, hands-on design and working directly with our technicians on the vehicles as part of our standard practice. You will have the opportunity to collaborate and coordinate with multiple groups, including structural integrity, systems, structures, production/maintenance control and supply chain. Focus on timeliness and execution of tasks and deliverables every day. Support the company strategy by holding ourselves and one another accountable for getting the work done.

* Develops engineering drawings for parts, assemblies and installations in 3DExperience and CATIA V5.
* Creates Process Specifications and Engineering Standards.
* Supports team in developing documents to support flight operations.
* Aids Production/Maintenance by producing repair/rework dispositions.
* Provides accountability by maintaining Actions item and Burn Down lists to support development teams and Maintenance Operations.
* Produces custom reports such as long lead items and discrepancy lists.
* Performs trade studies of multiple solutions to present to program leadership.
* Demonstrates flexibility in design philosophy to quickly pivot between solutions to support turn times and commercial goals.
* Directs the application of existing principles and guides development of new policies and ideas.
* Drives safety behavior and Foreign Object Debris (FOD awareness/prevention; ensuring adherence to regulatory protocols and rules.
* Works collaboratively to achieve goals and/or complete assigned tasks.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. You will play a critical role in developing, optimizing, and maintaining the embedded systems that power our robots. This role involves working on real-time operating systems (RTOS), low-Level firmware, and communication protocols to enable precise motor control, sensor integration, and robust system performance.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You will develop and maintain firmware for robotic control platforms, ensuring reliability and performance.
* You will design, implement, and optimize software for real-time operating systems such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or Zephyr.

  

* You will design and implement communication protocols over CAN and RS485 for motor control, sensor data acquisition, and power management.

  

* You will analyze and optimize system performance, including timing, resource usage, and latency, and conduct testing using scripting languages like Python for automated testing and data analysis.

  

* You will work closely with hardware and robotics engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and power systems.

  

* You will troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues using debugging tools and techniques.

  

* You will create clear, concise documentation for firmware designs, APIs, and test procedures.

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
  
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
  
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
  
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
  
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, or systems engineering
* Experience in embedded development in C/C++, or experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
* Proven experience with RTOS platforms such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or Zephyr including system performance characterization and design for realtime performance
* Extensive hands-on experience developing firmware for STM32 microcontrollers and familiarity with the ST Micro IDEs and toolchains

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Familiarity with robotics frameworks and simulation tools such as ROS and Isaac Sim
* Familiarity with safety-critical systems and fail-safe mechanisms
* Experience with motor control
* Experience with sensor fusion algorithms

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

**Location:** Austin, TX (US), San Francisco, CA (US), New York City (US), London (UK)

Cloudflare's Infrastructure Team builds and runs the systems and software that support our solutions that handle trillions of requests per month. We ensure that all of the new and existing features and functionality that Cloudflare offers can be managed at scale and meet the needs of our massively growing, global customer base.

**About the role**

As a Software Engineer, Deploy at Scale, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the platform that powers safe, reliable, and automated deployments across Cloudflare. We are looking for engineers to join the Deploy@Scale team and help shape the next phase of deployment automation, release safety, and AI-assisted operations. The Release Manager platform is pivotal in ensuring service resiliency by orchestrating progressive deployments, supporting health-mediated rollouts, and automating release workflows at scale. Our mission is to make deployments seamless, predictable, observable for all engineering teams across Cloudflare.

**Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience**

* At least 4 years of hands-on software development experience on meaningfully complex systems.
* Experience building both backend systems and frontend widgets.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Hardware Design Engineer (PCB Design), you’ll develop and verify printed circuit board (PCB) designs for electronic hardware and integrated systems. You’ll move designs from requirements and schematics through simulation, testing, debugging, and manufacturing readiness. Your impact: Reliable, well-verified hardware helps engineering and manufacturing teams build systems that perform as intended.

**Duties**

* Create PCB layouts, circuit designs, electrical schematics, and system designs using computer-aided design (CAD) software; coordinate with mechanical engineering on fit and integration.
* Apply signal processing, communications systems, control systems, and electrical systems knowledge to hardware for systems-on-chip (SoC), field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), ARM-based platforms, and firmware.
* Use simulation tools, MATLAB, Simulink, Python, C++, SystemVerilog, Perl, or other scripting and programming tools as appropriate for design and verification.
* Conduct engineering testing, soldering, surface-mount technology (SMT) work, debugging, and root cause analysis with oscilloscopes, ohmmeters, and vision inspection systems.
* Support project scheduling, manufacturing, automation, industrial automation, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and system development verification.

**Experience**

* Electrical engineering, electronics design, PCB design, design engineering, electrical system design, or related electrical experience.
* Experience practicing in an industrial or manufacturing engineering role is relevant; demonstrate engineering troubleshooting and mechanical knowledge.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, MicroStation, SolidWorks, electrical schematic design, and schematics is useful; not every tool is required.
* Knowledge of NEC (National Electrical Code), NFPA 70 compliance, and electrical building codes is preferred where applicable.
* Exposure to quantum engineering, Arduino, and engineering testing or simulation tools is a plus.

Pay: $40.00 - $50.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

The role works collaboratively across engineering, maintenance, operations, and IT teams to analyze processes, troubleshoot control system issues, and develop solutions that meet both business and technical requirements.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Software Engineer: Networking & Hardware-in-the-Loop**
========================================================

First Order Effects · Austin, TX

**Who We Are**
--------------

First Order Effects (FOE) is building America's Infrastructure Prime for the robotic era. Autonomous ships, drones, and robots are rewriting how the world moves, fights, and builds - but none of them work without infrastructure to power them, connect them, and launch and recover them. That's what we build.

**We've Built Cutting Edge Systems at Legendary Companies**
-----------------------------------------------------------

Our team comes from SpaceX, Anduril, Saronic, Lockheed Skunk Works, Forterra, and Fuse Energy. Before founding FOE, we built satellite ground stations that closed a national comms gap in days, deployed multi-megawatt power systems at commercial speed, and shipped autonomous surface vessels into Navy fleet production. We've built infrastructure at lightspeed before - now we're applying that playbook to an entire company.

**The Role**
------------

* Own the network inside Surge Hub, our rapidly deployable power system. Take today's early design and turn it into a secure, production-ready architecture.
* Segment traffic so control traffic stays isolated, while the devices that need internet connectivity get a clean, secure path out.
* Build for uptime: backup WAN, failover, and a network that holds when a link drops in the field.
* Design with security in mind from the first switch, not as a retrofit.
* Own the hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test network in our Austin warehouse. Bring every Surge Hub component onto one test network and drive it with your code.
* Write portable test and automation software for Surge Hub and its test equipment, and integrate it with the product's C/C++ firmware and software.
* Build it from the ground up. You pick the equipment, set the architecture, and own the result.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, and own HITL test systems: rack the hardware, connect it, and make software test it for real.
* Configure and maintain real networks, including switches, routers, VLANs, subnets, and firewalls, on hardware that ships.
* Live in Linux day to day.
* Write automation and test code in Python.
* Take projects from idea to outcome without waiting for a spec. Two or more years doing this on hardware products counts for more than a long resume of adjacent work.
* Bring a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or the shipped work that proves the same.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Network security depth: segmentation, hardening, firewall policy, and secure remote access.
* C and C++. Surge Hub firmware and software are written in them.
* A background in hardware or embedded products: power, aerospace, automotive, robotics, or defense. The domain matters less than the hardware.
* Startup experience, or time at a hard-tech company where you owned more than your title said.

**Compensation**
----------------

$140,000–$200,000 base + equity + benefits.

**ITAR requirement**
--------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations (ITAR/EAR), applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance; active clearance not required.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you!

  

We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA’s pursuits in deep space exploration. As NASA’s largest engineering solutions provider working together with NASA at centers across the United States.

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Cybersecurity Space Systems Engineer** to join the JETSII Contract!

This role is a unique blend of space engineering and cybersecurity. Instead of focusing solely on how a spacecraft works, this position focuses on how to keep it safe from deliberate cyber threats. You will help protect the full range of NASA mission systems: from the spacecraft and its onboard computers to the communication links that send commands to the ground systems that support missions.

A cyber-attack on a NASA spacecraft isn’t just a technical problem. It can threaten astronaut safety and put extremely valuable scientific missions at risk. In this role, you will help design systems that can detect unusual behavior, isolate issues, and recover on their own while in space.

You will help plan, build, and test cybersecurity features that ensure NASA’s missions remain safe, reliable, and resilient, even under challenging conditions.

The **Cybersecurity Space Systems Engineer** will:

* Conduct threat modeling across the spacecraft, communication links, and ground systems using space focused security tools (e.g., SPARTA) and methods.
* Design secure ways for a spacecraft’s internal systems to communicate (cryptographic key management framework) without slowing down critical operations.
* Review outside software and code before it is compiled into the flight software ensuring nothing harmful is introduced.
* Develop lightweight monitoring tools that monitor for unexpected behavior in telemetry, commands, or onboard systems.
* Build automated safety responses so the spacecraft can quickly isolate a threat and protect essential systems even without real time support from Earth.
* Lead cross-functional teams through practice or real cybersecurity events, helping coordinate actions between ground stations, network engineering teams, and flight operations to securely patch or override flight software.
* Evaluate engineering designs evaluate designs, interface control documents (ICDs), and flight software architectures to ensure adherence to rigorous cyber-resiliency baselines.
* Translate cybersecurity goals into traditional space system engineering deliverables.
* Perform engineering trade studies to find the right balance between strong cybersecurity postures (e.g., cryptographic overhead, zero-trust auditing) against the limited power, computing, and communication resources available in space.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Experience participating in or reviewing major design milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR).
* Understanding of the systems engineering lifecycle, including writing verifiable requirements, managing verification matrices (V&V via test, analysis, inspection, demonstration), and configuration management.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.
* Experience weighing cybersecurity needs against spacecraft constraints (e.g., CPU limitations, thermal footprints, limited power budgets, and low-telemetry bandwidth).
* Experience working across disciplines and explaining cyber risks to engineers and mission leaders who may not specialize in cybersecurity.

**Requisition Preferences:**

* 5–8 years of growing experience in space systems engineering.

  

* Master’s degree in Space Systems Engineering with work focused on Cybersecurity Embedded Systems Security, or Autonomous System Resiliency.
* Strong understanding of real time operating systems (like VxWorks, RTEMS, or NASA Core Flight System) and lower level programming used in spacecraft software (C/C++).

* Knowledge of how to protect onboard artificial intelligence

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Space Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you!

  

We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA’s pursuits in deep space exploration. As NASA’s largest engineering solutions provider working together with NASA at centers across the United States.

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Cybersecurity Space Systems Engineer** to join the JETSII Contract!

This role is a unique blend of space engineering and cybersecurity. Instead of focusing solely on how a spacecraft works, this position focuses on how to keep it safe from deliberate cyber threats. You will help protect the full range of NASA mission systems: from the spacecraft and its onboard computers to the communication links that send commands to the ground systems that support missions.

A cyber-attack on a NASA spacecraft isn’t just a technical problem. It can threaten astronaut safety and put extremely valuable scientific missions at risk. In this role, you will help design systems that can detect unusual behavior, isolate issues, and recover on their own while in space.

You will help plan, build, and test cybersecurity features that ensure NASA’s missions remain safe, reliable, and resilient, even under challenging conditions.

The **Cybersecurity Space Systems Engineer** will:

* Conduct threat modeling across the spacecraft, communication links, and ground systems using space focused security tools (e.g., SPARTA) and methods.
* Design secure ways for a spacecraft’s internal systems to communicate (cryptographic key management framework) without slowing down critical operations.
* Review outside software and code before it is compiled into the flight software ensuring nothing harmful is introduced.
* Develop lightweight monitoring tools that monitor for unexpected behavior in telemetry, commands, or onboard systems.
* Build automated safety responses so the spacecraft can quickly isolate a threat and protect essential systems even without real time support from Earth.
* Lead cross-functional teams through practice or real cybersecurity events, helping coordinate actions between ground stations, network engineering teams, and flight operations to securely patch or override flight software.
* Evaluate engineering designs evaluate designs, interface control documents (ICDs), and flight software architectures to ensure adherence to rigorous cyber-resiliency baselines.
* Translate cybersecurity goals into traditional space system engineering deliverables.
* Perform engineering trade studies to find the right balance between strong cybersecurity postures (e.g., cryptographic overhead, zero-trust auditing) against the limited power, computing, and communication resources available in space.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Requisition Qualifications:**

*This position has been posted at multiple levels. Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised.*

* Typically requires a bachelor's degree in Engineering and a minimum of 2- 5 years of experience in the field or in a related area.
* Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or STEM field such as Aerospace, Space Systems, Computer, Software, or Electrical Engineering.
* Experience participating in or reviewing major design milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR).
* Understanding of the systems engineering lifecycle, including writing verifiable requirements, managing verification matrices (V&V via test, analysis, inspection, demonstration), and configuration management.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.
* Experience weighing cybersecurity needs against spacecraft constraints (e.g., CPU limitations, thermal footprints, limited power budgets, and low-telemetry bandwidth).
* Experience working across disciplines and explaining cyber risks to engineers and mission leaders who may not specialize in cybersecurity.

**Requisition Preferences:**

* 5–8 years of growing experience in space systems engineering.
* Master’s degree in Space Systems Engineering with work focused on Cybersecurity Embedded Systems Security, or Autonomous System Resiliency.
* Strong understanding of real time operating systems (like VxWorks, RTEMS, or NASA Core Flight System) and lower level programming used in spacecraft software (C/C++).
* Experience applying defensive cybersecurity concepts directly to aerospace systems.
* Experience working with intrusion detection systems (IDS), SIEM, packet capture analytics, and telemetry log analysis scaled down for resource-constrained environments.
* Knowledge of how to protect onboard artificial intelligence

**Compensation:**

* Salary starts at $83,700. Final pay will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications.

**Why Join Our Team?**

In addition to exciting career opportunities, we also ave:

* Excellent personal and professional career growth
* 9/80 work schedule (every other Friday off), when applicable
* Onsite cafeteria (breakfast & lunch)
* Much, much more!

For more information on our partnership with NASA at Johnson Space Center (JSC), please visit www.wehavespaceforyou.com

* Proof of U.S. Citizenship or US Permanent Residency may be a requirement for this position.
* Must be able to complete a U.S. government background investigation.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Construction
jobs.description:
*Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.*

Robotics Software Engineer - Construction

**Job Description:**
====================

The Robotics Software Engineer is responsible for developing and deploying autonomous robotics solutions that must operate in some of the most challenging real-world environments. This role will own work across the development lifecycle: creating proof-of-concept prototypes, maturing promising concepts into feature-complete systems, and hardening those systems for reliable deployment on jobsites.

This team member reports to the Robotics Software Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who has a deep system-level understanding of what it takes for robots to operate in unstructured environments, handle dynamic obstacles, safely work around people, and work reliably with limited networking and power infrastructure. Although they may specialize in autonomy, perception, or manipulation, they are comfortable contributing across the robotics stack and addressing issues that span software, sensors, compute, networking, and mechanical hardware. They can move quickly when building an early proof-of-concept while applying the engineering discipline needed to mature it into a field-ready solution.

We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Robotics Software & Systems Integration

* Design, develop, integrate, and test software for complex field robotics applications.
* Support the development and maturation of the HITT robotics software stack.
* Integrate robot platforms, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, networks, and operator interfaces into cohesive systems.
* Develop field-ready autonomy capabilities, including localization, mapping, navigation, state estimation, and mission planning.
* Integrate perception pipelines using cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, inertial sensors, and other sensing modalities.
* Develop manipulation applications involving motion planning, controls, end effectors, calibration, and task execution.
* Use simulation, synthetic data, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and repeatable test environments to accelerate development and reduce field risk.
* Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity on robots, sensors, operator interfaces, and cloud services using wired and wireless networks.
* Serve as a strong technical contributor across the stack while bringing depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in every discipline is not expected.

Collaboration & Partnerships

* Collaborate with software engineers, hardware engineers, field testing engineers, vendors, partners, end users, and other stakeholders.
* Integrate and extend third-party technologies using APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces.
* Contribute to co-development efforts with vendors and technology partners to establish technical requirements, resolve integration challenges, and evaluate solutions.

Field Testing & Deployment

* Plan and execute structured testing in the lab, at test sites, and on active construction projects.
* Deploy alongside field teams, observe real workflows, collect data, diagnose issues, and convert field feedback into engineering priorities.
* Design for difficult real-world conditions, including dust, changing lighting, uneven terrain, vibration, intermittent connectivity, dynamic obstacles, and frequent environmental change.
* Support deployed systems through remote and on-site troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or 2+ years of experience in developing, integrating, and testing field robotics systems.
* Proficiency in C++, Python, and Linux-based robotics development.
* Proficiency in modern software-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker).
* Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution.
* Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
* Strong system-level troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking, and field operations.
* Ability to work effectively in uncertain, fast-moving environments and take ownership of open-ended technical problems.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics in written and verbal formats to various audiences.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize tasks across multiple projects.
* Willingness to travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing and deployment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real-world environments.
